hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيُّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنَ وَقَّاصٍ اللَّيْثِيَّ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِقَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى دُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوْ إِلَى امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Al Humaidi Abdullah bin Az Zubair] dia berkata, Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Sufyan] yang berkata, bahwa Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Yahya bin Sa'id Al Anshari] berkata, telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Muhammad bin Ibrahim At Taimi], bahwa dia pernah mendengar [Alqamah bin Waqash Al Laitsi] berkata; saya pernah mendengar [Umar bin Al Khaththab] diatas mimbar berkata; saya mendengar Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Semua perbuatan tergantung niatnya, dan (balasan) bagi tiap-tiap orang (tergantung) apa yang diniatkan; Barangsiapa niat hijrahnya karena dunia yang ingin digapainya atau karena seorang perempuan yang ingin dinikahinya, maka hijrahnya adalah kepada apa dia diniatkan"
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Al Humaidi Abdullah bin Az Zubair], he said, narrated to us [Sufyan], who said that narrated to us [Yahya bin Sa'id Al Anshari], who said, informed us [Muhammad bin Ibrahim At Taimi], that he heard [Alqamah bin Waqash Al Laitsi] say; I heard [Umar bin Al Khaththab] on the pulpit say; I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, say: "All deeds depend on intentions, and (the reward) for every person (depends) on what he intended; whoever's hijrah is for worldly gain that he wants to attain or for a woman he wants to marry, then his hijrah is to whatever he intended."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Al Humaidi Abdullah bin Az Zubair], 彼は言った, 私たちに語った [Sufyan], who 言った that 私たちに語った [Yahya bin Sa'id Al Anshari], who 言った, 私たちに伝えた [Muhammad bin Ibrahim At Taimi], that he heard [Alqamah bin Waqash Al Laitsi] say; 私は聞いた [Umar bin Al Khaththab] 説教壇の上で say; 私は聞いた the アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, say: "すべての行い 依る on 意図, and (the 報奨) for 各人 (depends) on what he 意図した; whoever's ヒジュラ is for 現世の利益 that he wants to attain or for a 女性 he wants to 結婚する, then his ヒジュラ is to whatever he 意図した."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Al Humaidi Abdullah bin Az Zubair], he 말했다, 우리에게 전했다 [Sufyan], who 말했다 that 우리에게 전했다 [Yahya bin Sa'id Al Anshari], who 말했다, informed us [Muhammad bin Ibrahim At Taimi], that he heard [Alqamah bin Waqash Al Laitsi] say; 나는 들었다 [Umar bin Al Khaththab] 설교단 위에서 say; 나는 들었다 the 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), say: "모든 행위 달려 있다 on 의도, and (the 보상) for 각 사람 (depends) on what he 의도한; whoever's 히즈라 is for 현세의 이익 that he wants to attain or for a 여자 he wants to 결혼하다, then his 히즈라 is to whatever he 의도한."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Al Humaidi Abdullah bin Az Zubair], he 说, 向我们讲述 [Sufyan], who 说 that 向我们讲述 [Yahya bin Sa'id Al Anshari], who 说, informed us [Muhammad bin Ibrahim At Taimi], that he heard [Alqamah bin Waqash Al Laitsi] say; 我听到 [Umar bin Al Khaththab] 在讲台上 say; 我听到 the 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, say: "一切行为 取决于 on 意图, and (the 报酬) for 每个人 (depends) on what he 所意图的; whoever's 迁徙 is for 现世利益 that he wants to attain or for a 女子 he wants to 娶, then his 迁徙 is to whatever he 所意图的."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Al Humaidi Abdullah bin Az Zubair], he a dit, Nous a raconté [Sufyan], who a dit that Nous a raconté [Yahya bin Sa'id Al Anshari], who a dit, informed us [Muhammad bin Ibrahim At Taimi], that he heard [Alqamah bin Waqash Al Laitsi] say; J'ai entendu [Umar bin Al Khaththab] sur la chaire say; J'ai entendu the Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, say: "Tous les actes dépendent on intentions, and (the récompense) for chaque personne (depends) on what he avait l'intention; whoever's hijra is for gain mondain that he wants to attain or for a femme he wants to épouser, then his hijra is to whatever he avait l'intention."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Al Humaidi Abdullah bin Az Zubair], he sagte, Hat uns erzählt [Sufyan], who sagte that Hat uns erzählt [Yahya bin Sa'id Al Anshari], who sagte, informed us [Muhammad bin Ibrahim At Taimi], that he heard [Alqamah bin Waqash Al Laitsi] say; Ich hörte [Umar bin Al Khaththab] auf der Kanzel say; Ich hörte the Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, say: "Alle Taten hängen ab on Absichten, and (the Belohnung) for jeder Mensch (depends) on what he beabsichtigt hat; whoever's Hidschra is for weltlicher Gewinn that he wants to attain or for a Frau he wants to heiraten, then his Hidschra is to whatever he beabsichtigt hat."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Al Humaidi Abdullah bin Az Zubair], he ha detto, Ci ha narrato [Sufyan], who ha detto that Ci ha narrato [Yahya bin Sa'id Al Anshari], who ha detto, informed us [Muhammad bin Ibrahim At Taimi], that he heard [Alqamah bin Waqash Al Laitsi] say; Ho sentito [Umar bin Al Khaththab] sul pulpito say; Ho sentito the Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, say: "Tutte le azioni dipendono on intenzioni, and (the ricompensa) for ogni persona (depends) on what he ha inteso; whoever's hijra is for guadagno mondano that he wants to attain or for a donna he wants to sposare, then his hijra is to whatever he ha inteso."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَاأَنَّ الْحَارِثَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ يَأْتِيكَ الْوَحْيُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَحْيَانًا يَأْتِينِي مِثْلَ صَلْصَلَةِ الْجَرَسِ وَهُوَ أَشَدُّهُ عَلَيَّ فَيُفْصَمُ عَنِّي وَقَدْ وَعَيْتُ عَنْهُ مَا قَالَ وَأَحْيَانًا يَتَمَثَّلُ لِي الْمَلَكُ رَجُلًا فَيُكَلِّمُنِي فَأَعِي مَا يَقُولُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ يَنْزِلُ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْيُ فِي الْيَوْمِ الشَّدِيدِ الْبَرْدِ فَيَفْصِمُ عَنْهُ وَإِنَّ جَبِينَهُ لَيَتَفَصَّدُ عَرَقًا
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abdullah bin Yusuf] berkata, telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Malik] dari [Hisyam bin 'Urwah] dari [bapaknya] dari [Aisyah] Ibu Kaum Mu'minin, bahwa Al Harits bin Hisyam bertanya kepada Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam: "Wahai Rasulullah, bagaimana caranya wahyu turun kepada engkau?" Maka Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam menjawab: "Terkadang datang kepadaku seperti suara gemerincing lonceng dan cara ini yang paling berat buatku, lalu terhenti sehingga aku dapat mengerti apa yang disampaikan. Dan terkadang datang Malaikat menyerupai seorang laki-laki lalu berbicara kepadaku maka aku ikuti apa yang diucapkannya". Aisyah berkata: "Sungguh aku pernah melihat turunnya wahyu kepada Beliau shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam pada suatu hari yang sangat dingin lalu terhenti, dan aku lihat dahi Beliau mengucurkan keringat."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Abdullah bin Yusuf], who said, informed us [Malik] from [Hisyam bin 'Urwah] from [his father] from [Aisyah], Mother of the Believers, that Al Harits bin Hisyam asked the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him: "O Messenger of Allah, how does revelation come down to you?" So the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, answered: "Sometimes it comes to me like the ringing sound of a bell, and this is the hardest way for me, then it stops so that I can understand what was conveyed. And sometimes the Angel comes in the form of a man and then speaks to me, so I follow what he says." [Aisyah] said: "Indeed I once saw revelation coming down to him, peace be upon him, on a very cold day, then it stopped, and I saw his forehead pouring with sweat."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Abdullah bin Yusuf], who 言った, 私たちに伝えた [Malik] from [Hisyam bin 'Urwah] from [his father] from [Aisyah], 信者たちの母, that Al Harits bin Hisyam 尋ねた the アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）: "O 使者 of Allah, how does 啓示 come down to you?" So the アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, 答えた: "Sometimes it comes to me 鐘の鳴る音のように, and this is the 最も難しい way for me, then it 止まる so that I can 理解する what was 伝えられた. And sometimes the Angel 人の姿で来る and then 話す to me, so I 従う what he 言う." [Aisyah] 言った: "Indeed I かつて見た 啓示 降りてくる to him, peace be upon him, on a とても寒い日, then it stopped, and I saw his 額 汗を流して."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Abdullah bin Yusuf], who 말했다, informed us [Malik] from [Hisyam bin 'Urwah] from [his father] from [Aisyah], 믿는 자들의 어머니, that Al Harits bin Hisyam 물었다 the 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를): "O 사자 of Allah, how does 계시 come down to you?" So the 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), 대답했다: "Sometimes it comes to me 종소리처럼, and this is the 가장 어려운 way for me, then it 멈춘다 so that I can 이해하다 what was 전해졌다. And sometimes the Angel 사람의 모습으로 온다 and then 말한다 to me, so I 따르다 what he says." [Aisyah] 말했다: "Indeed I 한 번 보았다 계시 내려오는 to him, peace be upon him, on a 매우 추운 날, then it stopped, and I saw his 이마 땀을 흘리며."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Abdullah bin Yusuf], who 说, informed us [Malik] from [Hisyam bin 'Urwah] from [his father] from [Aisyah], 信士之母, that Al Harits bin Hisyam 问 the 安拉的使者（愿他平安）: "O 使者 of Allah, how does 启示 come down to you?" So the 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, 回答: "Sometimes it comes to me 像铃铛的叮当声, and this is the 最难受 way for me, then it 停下 so that I can 理解 what was 所传达的. And sometimes the Angel 以人的形象出现 and then 说话 to me, so I 跟随 what he says." [Aisyah] 说: "Indeed I 曾看见 启示 降临 to him, peace be upon him, on a 非常寒冷的一天, then it stopped, and I saw his 额头 汗流不止."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Abdullah bin Yusuf], who a dit, informed us [Malik] from [Hisyam bin 'Urwah] from [his father] from [Aisyah], Mère des croyants, that Al Harits bin Hisyam a demandé the Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui: "O messager of Allah, how does révélation come down to you?" So the Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, a répondu: "Sometimes it comes to me comme le tintement d'une cloche, and this is the le plus pénible way for me, then it s'arrête so that I can comprendre what was transmis. And sometimes the Angel vient sous la forme d'un homme and then parle to me, so I suivre what he says." [Aisyah] a dit: "Indeed I ai vu une fois révélation descendant to him, peace be upon him, on a jour très froid, then it stopped, and I saw his front ruisselant de sueur."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Abdullah bin Yusuf], who sagte, informed us [Malik] from [Hisyam bin 'Urwah] from [his father] from [Aisyah], Mutter der Gläubigen, that Al Harits bin Hisyam fragte the Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm: "O Bote of Allah, how does Offenbarung come down to you?" So the Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, antwortete: "Sometimes it comes to me wie das Klingeln einer Glocke, and this is the schwerste way for me, then it hört auf so that I can verstehen what was übermittelt wurde. And sometimes the Angel kommt in Gestalt eines Mannes and then spricht to me, so I folge what he says." [Aisyah] sagte: "Indeed I sah einmal Offenbarung herabkommen to him, peace be upon him, on a sehr kalter Tag, then it stopped, and I saw his Stirn von Schweiß triefend."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Abdullah bin Yusuf], who ha detto, informed us [Malik] from [Hisyam bin 'Urwah] from [his father] from [Aisyah], Madre dei credenti, that Al Harits bin Hisyam ha chiesto the Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui: "O messaggero of Allah, how does rivelazione come down to you?" So the Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, ha risposto: "Sometimes it comes to me come il suono di una campana, and this is the il più duro way for me, then it si ferma so that I can capire what was trasmesso. And sometimes the Angel viene in forma di uomo and then parla to me, so I seguo what he says." [Aisyah] ha detto: "Indeed I ho visto una volta rivelazione che scendeva to him, peace be upon him, on a giorno molto freddo, then it stopped, and I saw his fronte che grondava sudore."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْأَوَّلُ مَا بُدِئَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ الْوَحْيِ الرُّؤْيَا الصَّالِحَةُ فِي النَّوْمِ فَكَانَ لَا يَرَى رُؤْيَا إِلَّا جَاءَتْ مِثْلَ فَلَقِ الصُّبْحِ ثُمَّ حُبِّبَ إِلَيْهِ الْخَلَاءُ وَكَانَ يَخْلُو بِغَارِ حِرَاءٍ فَيَتَحَنَّثُ فِيهِ وَهُوَ التَّعَبُّدُ اللَّيَالِيَ ذَوَاتِ الْعَدَدِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْزِعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ وَيَتَزَوَّدُ لِذَلِكَ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى خَدِيجَةَ فَيَتَزَوَّدُ لِمِثْلِهَا حَتَّى جَاءَهُ الْحَقُّ وَهُوَ فِي غَارِ حِرَاءٍ فَجَاءَهُ الْمَلَكُ فَقَالَ اقْرَأْ قَالَ مَا أَنَا بِقَارِئٍ قَالَ فَأَخَذَنِي فَغَطَّنِي حَتَّى بَلَغَ مِنِّي الْجَهْدَ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَنِي فَقَالَ اقْرَأْ قُلْتُ مَا أَنَا بِقَارِئٍ فَأَخَذَنِي فَغَطَّنِي الثَّانِيَةَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ مِنِّي الْجَهْدَ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَنِي فَقَالَ اقْرَأْ فَقُلْتُ مَا أَنَا بِقَارِئٍ فَأَخَذَنِي فَغَطَّنِي الثَّالِثَةَ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَنِي فَقَالَ{ اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ خَلَقَ الْإِنْسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ }فَرَجَعَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَرْجُفُ فُؤَادُهُ فَدَخَلَ عَلَى خَدِيجَةَ بِنْتِ خُوَيْلِدٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا فَقَالَ زَمِّلُونِي زَمِّلُونِي فَزَمَّلُوهُ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ الرَّوْعُ فَقَالَ لِخَدِيجَةَ وَأَخْبَرَهَا الْخَبَرَ لَقَدْ خَشِيتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي فَقَالَتْ خَدِيجَةُ كَلَّا وَاللَّهِ مَا يُخْزِيكَ اللَّهُ أَبَدًا إِنَّكَ لَتَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ وَتَحْمِلُ الْكَلَّ وَتَكْسِبُ الْمَعْدُومَ وَتَقْرِي الضَّيْفَ وَتُعِينُ عَلَى نَوَائِبِ الْحَقِّ فَانْطَلَقَتْ بِهِ خَدِيجَةُ حَتَّى أَتَتْ بِهِ وَرَقَةَ بْنَ نَوْفَلِ بْنِ أَسَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعُزَّى ابْنَ عَمِّ خَدِيجَةَ وَكَانَ امْرَأً قَدْ تَنَصَّرَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَكَانَ يَكْتُبُ الْكِتَابَ الْعِبْرَانِيَّ فَيَكْتُبُ مِنْ الْإِنْجِيلِ بِالْعِبْرَانِيَّةِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ وَكَانَ شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا قَدْ عَمِيَ فَقَالَتْ لَهُ خَدِيجَةُ يَا ابْنَ عَمِّ اسْمَعْ مِنْ ابْنِ أَخِيكَ فَقَالَ لَهُ وَرَقَةُ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي مَاذَا تَرَى فَأَخْبَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَبَرَ مَا رَأَى فَقَالَ لَهُ وَرَقَةُ هَذَا النَّامُوسُ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى مُوسَى يَا لَيْتَنِي فِيهَا جَذَعًا لَيْتَنِي أَكُونُ حَيًّا إِذْ يُخْرِجُكَ قَوْمُكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَوَمُخْرِجِيَّ هُمْ قَالَ نَعَمْ لَمْ يَأْتِ رَجُلٌ قَطُّ بِمِثْلِ مَا جِئْتَ بِهِ إِلَّا عُودِيَ وَإِنْ يُدْرِكْنِي يَوْمُكَ أَنْصُرْكَ نَصْرًا مُؤَزَّرًا ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْشَبْ وَرَقَةُ أَنْ تُوُفِّيَ وَفَتَرَ الْوَحْيُقَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ قَالَ وَهُوَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ فَتْرَةِ الْوَحْيِ فَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ بَيْنَا أَنَا أَمْشِي إِذْ سَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا مِنْ السَّمَاءِ فَرَفَعْتُ بَصَرِي فَإِذَا الْمَلَكُ الَّذِي جَاءَنِي بِحِرَاءٍ جَالِسٌ عَلَى كُرْسِيٍّ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ فَرُعِبْتُ مِنْهُ فَرَجَعْتُ فَقُلْتُ زَمِّلُونِي زَمِّلُونِي فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى{ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ قُمْ فَأَنْذِرْ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ }فَحَمِيَ الْوَحْيُ وَتَتَابَعَ تَابَعَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ وَأَبُو صَالِحٍ وَتَابَعَهُ هِلَالُ بْنُ رَدَّادٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ وَقَالَ يُونُسُ وَمَعْمَرٌ بَوَادِرُهُ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Yahya bin Bukair] berkata, Telah menceritakan kepada kami dari [Al Laits] dari ['Uqail] dari [Ibnu Syihab] dari ['Urwah bin Az Zubair] dari [Aisyah] -Ibu Kaum Mu'minin-, bahwasanya dia berkata: "Permulaaan wahyu yang datang kepada Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam adalah dengan mimpi yang benar dalam tidur. Dan tidaklah Beliau bermimpi kecuali datang seperti cahaya subuh. Kemudian Beliau dianugerahi kecintaan untuk menyendiri, lalu Beliau memilih gua Hiro dan bertahannuts yaitu 'ibadah di malam hari dalam beberapa waktu lamanya sebelum kemudian kembali kepada keluarganya guna mempersiapkan bekal untuk bertahannuts kembali. Kemudian Beliau menemui Khadijah mempersiapkan bekal. Sampai akhirnya datang Al Haq saat Beliau di gua Hiro, Malaikat datang seraya berkata: "Bacalah?" Beliau menjawab: "Aku tidak bisa baca". Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam menjelaskan: Maka Malaikat itu memegangku dan memelukku sangat kuat kemudian melepaskanku dan berkata lagi: "Bacalah!" Beliau menjawab: "Aku tidak bisa baca". Maka Malaikat itu memegangku dan memelukku sangat kuat kemudian melepaskanku dan berkata lagi: "Bacalah!". Beliau menjawab: "Aku tidak bisa baca". Malaikat itu memegangku kembali dan memelukku untuk ketiga kalinya dengan sangat kuat lalu melepaskanku, dan berkata lagi: (Bacalah dengan (menyebut) nama Tuhanmu yang Menciptakan, Dia Telah menciptakan manusia dari segumpal darah. Bacalah, dan Tuhanmulah yang Maha Pemurah)." Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam kembali kepada keluarganya dengan membawa kalimat wahyu tadi dalam keadaan gelisah. Beliau menemui Khadijah binti Khawailidh seraya berkata: "Selimuti aku, selimuti aku!". Beliau pun diselimuti hingga hilang ketakutannya. Lalu Beliau menceritakan peristiwa yang terjadi kepada Khadijah: "Aku mengkhawatirkan diriku". Maka Khadijah berkata: "Demi Allah, Allah tidak akan mencelakakanmu selamanya, karena engkau adalah orang yang menyambung silaturrahim." Khadijah kemudian mengajak Beliau untuk bertemu dengan Waroqoh bin Naufal bin Asad bin Abdul 'Uzza, putra paman Khadijah, yang beragama Nasrani di masa Jahiliyyah, dia juga menulis buku dalam bahasa Ibrani, juga menulis Kitab Injil dalam Bahasa Ibrani dengan izin Allah. Saat itu Waroqoh sudah tua dan matanya buta. Khadijah berkata: "Wahai putra pamanku, dengarkanlah apa yang akan disampaikan oleh putra saudaramu ini". Waroqoh berkata: "Wahai putra saudaraku, apa yang sudah kamu alami". Maka Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam menuturkan peristiwa yang dialaminya. Waroqoh berkata: "Ini adalah Namus, seperti yang pernah Allah turunkan kepada Musa. Duhai seandainya aku masih muda dan aku masih hidup saat kamu nanti diusir oleh kaummu". Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bertanya: "Apakah aku akan diusir mereka?" Waroqoh menjawab: "Iya. Karena tidak ada satu orang pun yang datang dengan membawa seperti apa yang kamu bawa ini kecuali akan disakiti (dimusuhi). Seandainya aku ada saat kejadian itu, pasti aku akan menolongmu dengan sekemampuanku". Waroqoh tidak mengalami peristiwa yang diyakininya tersebut karena lebih dahulu meninggal dunia pada masa fatroh (kekosongan) wahyu. [Ibnu Syihab] berkata; telah mengabarkan kepadaku [Abu Salamah bin Abdurrahman] bahwa [Jabir bin Abdullah Al Anshari] bertutur tentang kekosongan wahyu, sebagaimana yang Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam ceritakan: "Ketika sedang berjalan aku mendengar suara dari langit, aku memandang ke arahnya dan ternyata Malaikat yang pernah datang kepadaku di gua Hiro, duduk di atas kursi antara langit dan bumi. Aku pun ketakutan dan pulang, dan berkata: "Selimuti aku. Selimuti aku". Maka Allah Ta'ala menurunkan wahyu: (Wahai orang yang berselimut) sampai firman Allah (dan berhala-berhala tinggalkanlah). Sejak saat itu wahyu terus turun berkesinambungan." Hadits ini juga diriwayatkan oleh [Abdullah bin Yusuf] dan [Abu Shalih] juga oleh [Hilal bin Raddad] dari [Az Zuhri]. Dan [Yunus] berkata; dan [Ma'mar] menyepakati bahwa dia mendapatkannya dari Az Zuhri.
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Yahya bin Bukair], who said, narrated to us from [Al Laits] from ['Uqail] from [Ibnu Syihab] from ['Urwah bin Az Zubair] from [Aisyah], Mother of the Believers, that she said: "The beginning of the revelation that came to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was with true dreams in sleep. And he did not dream except that it came like the light of dawn. Then he was granted a love of seclusion, so he chose the cave of Hira and practised tahannuts, that is, worship at night for a number of nights, before then returning to his family to prepare provisions to practise tahannuts again. Then he would meet Khadijah to prepare provisions. Until finally Al Haq came when he was in the cave of Hira; the Angel came and said: 'Read!' He answered: 'I cannot read.' The Prophet, peace be upon him, explained: Then the Angel seized me and embraced me very tightly, then released me and said again: 'Read!' He answered: 'I cannot read.' Then the Angel seized me and embraced me very tightly, then released me and said again: 'Read!' He answered: 'I cannot read.' The Angel seized me again and embraced me for the third time very tightly, then released me, and said again: (Read in the name of your Lord who created, He created man from a clot of blood. Read, and your Lord is the Most Generous). The Prophet, peace be upon him, returned to his family carrying the words of revelation in a state of anxiety. He met Khadijah bint Khawailidh and said: 'Cover me, cover me!' He was covered until his fear left him. Then he told Khadijah what had happened: 'I fear for myself.' Then Khadijah said: 'By Allah, Allah will never disgrace you, for you are one who joins the ties of kinship.' Khadijah then took him to meet Waraqah bin Naufal bin Asad bin Abdul 'Uzza, Khadijah's cousin, who was a Christian in the time of Jahiliyyah; he also wrote books in Hebrew, and wrote the Injil in Hebrew by Allah's permission. At that time Waraqah was old and his eyes were blind. Khadijah said: 'O son of my uncle, listen to what this son of your brother will tell.' Waraqah said: 'O son of my brother, what have you experienced?' So the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, told him what he had experienced. Waraqah said: 'This is the Namus, like that which Allah sent down to Musa. Oh, if only I were still young and still alive when you are driven out by your people.' The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, asked: 'Will I be driven out by them?' Waraqah answered: 'Yes. For there is no one who came bringing what you bring except that he will be harmed (opposed). If I were present at that time, I would surely help you as much as I could.' Waraqah did not live to see what he believed in, for he died first during the fatrah (the pause) of revelation. [Ibnu Syihab] said; [Abu Salamah bin Abdurrahman] informed me that [Jabir bin Abdullah Al Anshari] spoke about the pause in revelation, as the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, told: 'While I was walking I heard a voice from the sky, I looked towards it and it turned out to be the Angel who had come to me in the cave of Hira, sitting on a chair between heaven and earth. I became afraid and went home, and said: 'Cover me. Cover me.' Then Allah Ta'ala sent down revelation: (O you who are wrapped up) until the words of Allah (and leave the idols). Since then revelation continued without interruption.' This hadith was also narrated by [Abdullah bin Yusuf] and [Abu Shalih], and also by [Hilal bin Raddad] from [Az Zuhri]. And [Yunus] said; and [Ma'mar] agreed that he got it from Az Zuhri."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Yahya bin Bukair], who 言った, 私たちに語った from [Al Laits] from ['Uqail] from [Ibnu Syihab] from ['Urwah bin Az Zubair] from [Aisyah], 信者たちの母, that she 言った: "The 始まり of the 啓示 that came to the アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, was with 真実の夢 in 睡眠. And he did not dream except that it came like the 夜明けの光. Then he was 授けられた a 隠遁への愛, so he 選んだ the ヒラー洞窟 and タハンヌスを行った, that is, 礼拝 at 夜 for a 幾夜か, before then 戻って to his 家族 to 食糧を用意する to practise tahannuts 再び. Then he would 会う Khadijah to 食糧を用意する. Until ついに 真理 came when he was in the ヒラー洞窟; the Angel came and 言った: 'Read!' He 答えた: 'I 読めない.' 預言者（彼に平安あれ）, 説明した: Then the Angel つかんだ me and 抱きしめた me とても強く, then 離した me and 言った 再び: 'Read!' He 答えた: 'I 読めない.' Then the Angel つかんだ me and 抱きしめた me とても強く, then 離した me and 言った 再び: 'Read!' He 答えた: 'I 読めない.' The Angel つかんだ me 再び and 抱きしめた me for the 三度目 とても強く, then 離した me, and 言った 再び: (Read in the あなたの主の御名 who 創造した, He 創造した 人間 from a 血の塊. Read, and your Lord is the 最も寛大な方). 預言者（彼に平安あれ）, returned to his 家族 carrying the 啓示の言葉 in a 不安な状態. He 会った Khadijah bint Khawailidh and 言った: '私を覆ってくれ, 私を覆ってくれ!' He was 覆ってくれ 彼の恐れが去るまで. Then he 語った Khadijah 起きたこと: 'I 自分を恐れる.' Then Khadijah 言った: 'アッラーにかけて, Allah 決してあなたを辱めない, なぜならあなたは結ぶ者だから the 親族の絆.' Khadijah then 彼を会わせに連れて行った Waraqah bin Naufal bin Asad bin Abdul 'Uzza, Khadijah's いとこ, who was a Christian in the time of Jahiliyyah; he also 書物を書いた in Hebrew, and wrote the Injil in Hebrew アッラーの許可によって. その時 Waraqah was 老いた and his eyes were 盲目. Khadijah 言った: 'O 叔父の息子よ, 聞け to what this son of your brother will tell.' Waraqah 言った: 'O 兄弟の息子よ, 何を経験したのか?' So the アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, 彼に語った 彼が経験したこと. Waraqah 言った: 'This is the Namus, like that which Allah sent down to Musa. ああ、私がまだ若かったら and まだ生きている あなたがあなたの民に追放される時.' The アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, 尋ねた: '私は彼らに追放されるのか?' Waraqah 答えた: 'Yes. For 誰もいない who 持って来た what you bring except that he 害されるだろう (opposed). もし私がその場にいたら その時, I きっとあなたを助けるだろう できる限り.' Waraqah 生きて見ることはなかった 彼が信じていたこと, for 彼は先に死んだ ファトラの間に (the 中断) of 啓示. [Ibnu Syihab] 言った; [Abu Salamah bin Abdurrahman] informed me that [Jabir bin Abdullah Al Anshari] 語った the 啓示の中断, as the アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, 語った: '私が歩いていると 私は聞いた a 天からの声, そちらを見た and それは〜だった the Angel 私のところに来た in the ヒラー洞窟, 椅子に座って 天と地の間. 私は恐れた and 家に帰った, and 言った: '私を覆ってくれ. 私を覆ってくれ.' Then 至高のアッラー 啓示を下された: (O you who are くるまった) until the words of Allah (and 偶像を捨てよ). それ以来 啓示 途切れることなく続いた.' This hadith was また伝えられた by [Abdullah bin Yusuf] and [Abu Shalih], and also by [Hilal bin Raddad] from [Az Zuhri]. And [Yunus] 言った; and [Ma'mar] 同意した that 彼は〜から得た Az Zuhri."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Yahya bin Bukair], who 말했다, 우리에게 전했다 from [Al Laits] from ['Uqail] from [Ibnu Syihab] from ['Urwah bin Az Zubair] from [Aisyah], 믿는 자들의 어머니, that she 말했다: "The 시작 of the 계시 that came to the 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), was with 참된 꿈 in 잠. And he did not dream except that it came like the 새벽 빛. Then he was 베풀어졌다 a 은둔에 대한 사랑, so he 선택했다 the 히라 동굴 and 타한누스를 행했다, that is, 예배 at 밤 for a 여러 밤, before then 돌아가 to his 가족 to 식량을 준비하다 to practise tahannuts 다시. Then he would 만나다 Khadijah to 식량을 준비하다. Until 마침내 진리 came when he was in the 히라 동굴; the Angel came and 말했다: 'Read!' He 대답했다: 'I 읽을 수 없다.' The Prophet, peace be upon him, 설명했다: Then the Angel 붙잡았다 me and 껴안았다 me 매우 세게, then 놓아주었다 me and 말했다 다시: 'Read!' He 대답했다: 'I 읽을 수 없다.' Then the Angel 붙잡았다 me and 껴안았다 me 매우 세게, then 놓아주었다 me and 말했다 다시: 'Read!' He 대답했다: 'I 읽을 수 없다.' The Angel 붙잡았다 me 다시 and 껴안았다 me for the 세 번째 매우 세게, then 놓아주었다 me, and 말했다 다시: (Read in the 네 주의 이름 who 창조했다, He 창조했다 인간 from a 피 덩어리. Read, and your Lord is the 가장 관대하신 분). The Prophet, peace be upon him, returned to his 가족 carrying the 계시의 말씀 in a 불안한 상태. He 만났다 Khadijah bint Khawailidh and 말했다: '나를 덮어 달라, 나를 덮어 달라!' He was 덮어 달라 그의 두려움이 사라질 때까지. Then he 말했다 Khadijah 일어난 일: 'I 두려움 for myself.' Then Khadijah 말했다: '알라를 두고 맹세하건대, Allah 결코 너를 욕보이지 않을 것이다, for you are one who joins the 혈연 관계.' Khadijah then 그를 만나게 데려갔다 Waraqah bin Naufal bin Asad bin Abdul 'Uzza, Khadijah's 사촌, who was a Christian in the time of Jahiliyyah; he also 책을 썼다 in Hebrew, and wrote the Injil in Hebrew 알라의 허락으로. 그때 Waraqah was 늙은 and his eyes were 눈먼. Khadijah 말했다: 'O 삼촌의 아들이여, 들으라 to what this son of your brother will tell.' Waraqah 말했다: 'O 형제의 아들이여, 무엇을 경험했느냐?' So the 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), 그에게 말했다 what he had 겪었다. Waraqah 말했다: 'This is the Namus, like that which Allah sent down to Musa. 아, 내가 아직 젊었더라면 and 아직 살아 있다 네 백성에게 쫓겨날 때.' The 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), 물었다: '내가 그들에게 쫓겨날 것인가?' Waraqah 대답했다: 'Yes. For 아무도 없다 who 가져온 what you bring except that he 해를 입을 것이다 (opposed). 내가 그 자리에 있었다면 그때, I 반드시 너를 도울 것이다 할 수 있는 한.' Waraqah 살아서 보지 못했다 그가 믿었던 것, for 그는 먼저 죽었다 파트라 동안에 (the 중단) of 계시. [Ibnu Syihab] 말했다; [Abu Salamah bin Abdurrahman] informed me that [Jabir bin Abdullah Al Anshari] 말했다 the 계시의 중단, as the 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), 말했다: '내가 걷고 있을 때 나는 들었다 a 하늘에서 온 음성, 그쪽을 바라보았다 and 그것은 ~이었다 the Angel 내게 왔던 in the 히라 동굴, 의자에 앉아 하늘과 땅 사이에. 나는 두려워졌다 and 집으로 갔다, and 말했다: '나를 덮어 달라. 나를 덮어 달라.' Then 지존하신 알라 계시를 내리셨다: (O you who are 싸인 자) until the words of Allah (and 우상들을 버리라). 그때부터 계시 끊임없이 계속되었다.' This hadith was 또한 전해졌다 by [Abdullah bin Yusuf] and [Abu Shalih], and also by [Hilal bin Raddad] from [Az Zuhri]. And [Yunus] 말했다; and [Ma'mar] 동의했다 that 그는 ~로부터 얻었다 Az Zuhri."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Yahya bin Bukair], who 说, 向我们讲述 from [Al Laits] from ['Uqail] from [Ibnu Syihab] from ['Urwah bin Az Zubair] from [Aisyah], 信士之母, that she 说: "The 开端 of the 启示 that came to the 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, was with 真实的梦 in 睡眠. And he did not dream except that it came like the 黎明之光. Then he was 被赐予 a 喜爱独处, so he 选择了 the 希拉山洞 and 修行塔汉努特, that is, 崇拜 at 夜晚 for a 若干夜, before then 返回 to his 家人 to 准备干粮 to practise tahannuts 再一次. Then he would 去见 Khadijah to 准备干粮. Until 最后 真理 came when he was in the 希拉山洞; the Angel came and 说: 'Read!' He 回答: 'I 不会读.' The Prophet, peace be upon him, 解释说: Then the Angel 抓住了 me and 紧紧抱住 me 非常紧, then 放开 me and 说 再一次: 'Read!' He 回答: 'I 不会读.' Then the Angel 抓住了 me and 紧紧抱住 me 非常紧, then 放开 me and 说 再一次: 'Read!' He 回答: 'I 不会读.' The Angel 抓住了 me 再一次 and 紧紧抱住 me for the 第三次 非常紧, then 放开 me, and 说 再一次: (Read in the 你的主的名 who 创造了, He 创造了 人类 from a 血块. Read, and your Lord is the 最慷慨的主). The Prophet, peace be upon him, returned to his 家人 carrying the 启示的话语 in a 惶恐不安的状态. He 去见 Khadijah bint Khawailidh and 说: '给我盖上, 给我盖上!' He was 给我盖上 直到他的恐惧消除. Then he 讲述 Khadijah 发生的事: 'I 恐惧 for myself.' Then Khadijah 说: '以安拉发誓, Allah 绝不会使你受辱, for you are one who joins the 血缘关系.' Khadijah then 带他去见 Waraqah bin Naufal bin Asad bin Abdul 'Uzza, Khadijah's 堂兄弟, who was a Christian in the time of Jahiliyyah; he also 书写书籍 in Hebrew, and wrote the Injil in Hebrew 凭安拉的许可. 当时 Waraqah was 年老 and his eyes were 失明. Khadijah 说: 'O 我叔父的儿子啊, 听吧 to what this son of your brother will tell.' Waraqah 说: 'O 我兄弟的儿子啊, 你经历了什么?' So the 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, 告诉了他 what he had 经历了. Waraqah 说: 'This is the Namus, like that which Allah sent down to Musa. 但愿我还年轻 and 还活着 当你的族人驱逐你时.' The 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, 问: '我会被他们驱逐吗?' Waraqah 回答: 'Yes. For 没有一个人 who 带来 what you bring except that he 会受到伤害 (opposed). 如果我在场 当时, I 一定会帮助你 尽我所能.' Waraqah 没有活着看到 他所确信的事, for 他先去世了 在启示停顿期间 (the 停顿) of 启示. [Ibnu Syihab] 说; [Abu Salamah bin Abdurrahman] informed me that [Jabir bin Abdullah Al Anshari] 讲述了 the 启示的停顿, as the 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, 讲述: '当我行走时 我听到 a 来自天空的声音, 我向它望去 and 原来是 the Angel 曾到我这里来的 in the 希拉山洞, 坐在椅子上 在天地之间. 我感到害怕 and 回到家里, and 说: '给我盖上. 给我盖上.' Then 至高的安拉 降下启示: (O you who are 披衣的人) until the words of Allah (and 抛弃偶像). 从那时起 启示 不间断地继续.' This hadith was 也被传述 by [Abdullah bin Yusuf] and [Abu Shalih], and also by [Hilal bin Raddad] from [Az Zuhri]. And [Yunus] 说; and [Ma'mar] 一致认为 that 他从那里得到 Az Zuhri."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Yahya bin Bukair], who a dit, Nous a raconté from [Al Laits] from ['Uqail] from [Ibnu Syihab] from ['Urwah bin Az Zubair] from [Aisyah], Mère des croyants, that she a dit: "The début of the révélation that came to the Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, was with rêves véridiques in sommeil. And he did not dream except that it came like the lumière de l'aube. Then he was accordé a amour de la retraite, so he a choisi the grotte de Hira and pratiquait le tahannuts, that is, adoration at nuit for a plusieurs nuits, before then retournant to his famille to préparer des provisions to practise tahannuts à nouveau. Then he would rencontrer Khadijah to préparer des provisions. Until enfin Al Haq came when he was in the grotte de Hira; the Angel came and a dit: 'Read!' He a répondu: 'I ne sais pas lire.' The Prophet, peace be upon him, a expliqué: Then the Angel m'a saisi me and m'a serré me très fort, then m'a lâché me and a dit à nouveau: 'Read!' He a répondu: 'I ne sais pas lire.' Then the Angel m'a saisi me and m'a serré me très fort, then m'a lâché me and a dit à nouveau: 'Read!' He a répondu: 'I ne sais pas lire.' The Angel m'a saisi me à nouveau and m'a serré me for the troisième fois très fort, then m'a lâché me, and a dit à nouveau: (Read in the nom de ton Seigneur who a créé, He a créé homme from a caillot de sang. Read, and your Lord is the le plus Généreux). The Prophet, peace be upon him, returned to his famille carrying the paroles de la révélation in a état d'anxiété. He a rencontré Khadijah bint Khawailidh and a dit: 'Couvre-moi, Couvre-moi!' He was couvre-moi jusqu'à ce que sa peur le quitte. Then he a raconté Khadijah ce qui s'était passé: 'I peur for myself.' Then Khadijah a dit: 'Par Allah, Allah ne te déshonorera jamais, for you are one who joins the liens de parenté.' Khadijah then l'a emmené rencontrer Waraqah bin Naufal bin Asad bin Abdul 'Uzza, Khadijah's cousin, who was a Christian in the time of Jahiliyyah; he also écrivait des livres in Hebrew, and wrote the Injil in Hebrew avec la permission d'Allah. à cette époque Waraqah was vieux and his eyes were aveugle. Khadijah a dit: 'O fils de mon oncle, écoute to what this son of your brother will tell.' Waraqah a dit: 'O fils de mon frère, qu'as-tu vécu?' So the Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, lui a raconté what he had as vécu. Waraqah a dit: 'This is the Namus, like that which Allah sent down to Musa. Ah, si j'étais encore jeune and encore vivant quand tu seras chassé par ton peuple.' The Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, a demandé: 'Serai-je chassé par eux?' Waraqah a répondu: 'Yes. For il n'y a personne who est venu apportant what you bring except that he sera persécuté (opposed). Si j'étais présent à cette époque, I je t'aiderais sûrement autant que je le pourrais.' Waraqah n'a pas vécu pour voir ce en quoi il croyait, for il est mort d'abord pendant la fatrah (the pause) of révélation. [Ibnu Syihab] a dit; [Abu Salamah bin Abdurrahman] informed me that [Jabir bin Abdullah Al Anshari] a parlé the interruption de la révélation, as the Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, a raconté: 'Alors que je marchais J'ai entendu a voix du ciel, j'ai regardé vers elle and c'était the Angel qui était venu à moi in the grotte de Hira, assis sur une chaise entre ciel et terre. j'ai eu peur and suis rentré, and a dit: 'Couvre-moi. Couvre-moi.' Then Allah Très-Haut a fait descendre la révélation: (O you who are enveloppé) until the words of Allah (and délaisse les idoles). Depuis lors révélation a continué sans interruption.' This hadith was aussi rapporté by [Abdullah bin Yusuf] and [Abu Shalih], and also by [Hilal bin Raddad] from [Az Zuhri]. And [Yunus] a dit; and [Ma'mar] étaient d'accord that il l'a obtenu de Az Zuhri."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Yahya bin Bukair], who sagte, Hat uns erzählt from [Al Laits] from ['Uqail] from [Ibnu Syihab] from ['Urwah bin Az Zubair] from [Aisyah], Mutter der Gläubigen, that she sagte: "The Anfang of the Offenbarung that came to the Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, was with wahre Träume in Schlaf. And he did not dream except that it came like the Licht der Morgendämmerung. Then he was gewährt a Liebe zur Zurückgezogenheit, so he wählte the Höhle Hira and praktizierte Tahannuts, that is, Anbetung at Nacht for a Anzahl von Nächten, before then zurückkehrend to his Familie to Vorräte vorbereiten to practise tahannuts wieder. Then he would treffen Khadijah to Vorräte vorbereiten. Until schließlich Al Haq came when he was in the Höhle Hira; the Angel came and sagte: 'Read!' He antwortete: 'I kann nicht lesen.' The Prophet, peace be upon him, erklärte: Then the Angel packte mich me and umarmte mich me sehr fest, then ließ mich los me and sagte wieder: 'Read!' He antwortete: 'I kann nicht lesen.' Then the Angel packte mich me and umarmte mich me sehr fest, then ließ mich los me and sagte wieder: 'Read!' He antwortete: 'I kann nicht lesen.' The Angel packte mich me wieder and umarmte mich me for the drittes Mal sehr fest, then ließ mich los me, and sagte wieder: (Read in the Namen deines Herrn who erschaffen hat, He erschaffen hat Mensch from a Blutklumpen. Read, and your Lord is the Allergroßzügigste). The Prophet, peace be upon him, returned to his Familie carrying the Worte der Offenbarung in a Zustand der Unruhe. He traf Khadijah bint Khawailidh and sagte: 'Bedecke mich, Bedecke mich!' He was bedecke mich bis seine Furcht ihn verließ. Then he erzählte Khadijah was geschehen Krieg: 'I Furcht for myself.' Then Khadijah sagte: 'Bei Allah, Allah wird dich niemals entehren, for you are one who joins the Verwandtschaftsbande.' Khadijah then brachte ihn zu Waraqah bin Naufal bin Asad bin Abdul 'Uzza, Khadijah's Vetter, who was a Christian in the time of Jahiliyyah; he also schrieb Bücher in Hebrew, and wrote the Injil in Hebrew mit Allahs Erlaubnis. zu jener Zeit Waraqah was alt and his eyes were blind. Khadijah sagte: 'O Sohn meines Onkels, höre to what this son of your brother will tell.' Waraqah sagte: 'O Sohn meines Bruders, was hast du erlebt?' So the Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, erzählte ihm what he had erlebt hast. Waraqah sagte: 'This is the Namus, like that which Allah sent down to Musa. O, wäre ich doch noch jung and noch am Leben wenn du von deinem Volk vertrieben wirst.' The Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, fragte: 'Werde ich von ihnen vertrieben werden?' Waraqah antwortete: 'Yes. For es gibt niemanden who kam und brachte what you bring except that he wird geschädigt werden (opposed). Wäre ich anwesend zu jener Zeit, I würde ich dir sicherlich helfen so gut ich könnte.' Waraqah lebte nicht, um zu sehen woran er glaubte, for er starb zuerst während der Fatrah (the Pause) of Offenbarung. [Ibnu Syihab] sagte; [Abu Salamah bin Abdurrahman] informed me that [Jabir bin Abdullah Al Anshari] sprach über the Pause in der Offenbarung, as the Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, erzählte: 'Während ich ging Ich hörte a Stimme vom Himmel, ich blickte dorthin and es Krieg the Angel der zu mir gekommen Krieg in the Höhle Hira, auf einem Stuhl sitzend zwischen Himmel und Erde. ich bekam Angst and ging nach Hause, and sagte: 'Bedecke mich. Bedecke mich.' Then Allah, der Erhabene sandte Offenbarung herab: (O you who are Eingehüllter) until the words of Allah (and lasst die Götzen). Seitdem Offenbarung ging ohne Unterbrechung weiter.' This hadith was auch überliefert by [Abdullah bin Yusuf] and [Abu Shalih], and also by [Hilal bin Raddad] from [Az Zuhri]. And [Yunus] sagte; and [Ma'mar] waren sich einig that er es von ihm bekam Az Zuhri."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Yahya bin Bukair], who ha detto, Ci ha narrato from [Al Laits] from ['Uqail] from [Ibnu Syihab] from ['Urwah bin Az Zubair] from [Aisyah], Madre dei credenti, that she ha detto: "The inizio of the rivelazione that came to the Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, was with sogni veritieri in sonno. And he did not dream except that it came like the luce dell'alba. Then he was concesso a amore per il ritiro, so he ha scelto the grotta di Hira and praticava il tahannuts, that is, adorazione at notte for a alcune notti, before then tornando to his famiglia to preparare provviste to practise tahannuts di nuovo. Then he would incontrare Khadijah to preparare provviste. Until finalmente Al Haq came when he was in the grotta di Hira; the Angel came and ha detto: 'Read!' He ha risposto: 'I non so leggere.' The Prophet, peace be upon him, ha spiegato: Then the Angel mi ha afferrato me and mi ha abbracciato me molto forte, then mi ha lasciato me and ha detto di nuovo: 'Read!' He ha risposto: 'I non so leggere.' Then the Angel mi ha afferrato me and mi ha abbracciato me molto forte, then mi ha lasciato me and ha detto di nuovo: 'Read!' He ha risposto: 'I non so leggere.' The Angel mi ha afferrato me di nuovo and mi ha abbracciato me for the terza volta molto forte, then mi ha lasciato me, and ha detto di nuovo: (Read in the nome del tuo Signore who ha creato, He ha creato uomo from a grumo di sangue. Read, and your Lord is the il più Generoso). The Prophet, peace be upon him, returned to his famiglia carrying the parole della rivelazione in a stato di ansia. He ha incontrato Khadijah bint Khawailidh and ha detto: 'Coprimi, Coprimi!' He was coprimi finché la sua paura non lo lasciò. Then he ha raccontato Khadijah ciò che era accaduto: 'I paura for myself.' Then Khadijah ha detto: 'Per Allah, Allah non ti disonorerà mai, for you are one who joins the legami di parentela.' Khadijah then lo ha portato a incontrare Waraqah bin Naufal bin Asad bin Abdul 'Uzza, Khadijah's cugino, who was a Christian in the time of Jahiliyyah; he also scriveva libri in Hebrew, and wrote the Injil in Hebrew con il permesso di Allah. a quel tempo Waraqah was vecchio and his eyes were cieco. Khadijah ha detto: 'O figlio di mio zio, ascolta to what this son of your brother will tell.' Waraqah ha detto: 'O figlio di mio fratello, che cosa hai vissuto?' So the Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, gli ha raccontato what he had hai vissuto. Waraqah ha detto: 'This is the Namus, like that which Allah sent down to Musa. Oh, se fossi ancora giovane and ancora vivo quando sarai cacciato dal tuo popolo.' The Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, ha chiesto: 'Sarò cacciato da loro?' Waraqah ha risposto: 'Yes. For non c'è nessuno who è venuto portando what you bring except that he sarà danneggiato (opposed). Se fossi presente a quel tempo, I ti aiuterei sicuramente quanto potrei.' Waraqah non ha vissuto per vedere ciò in cui credeva, for è morto prima durante la fatrah (the pausa) of rivelazione. [Ibnu Syihab] ha detto; [Abu Salamah bin Abdurrahman] informed me that [Jabir bin Abdullah Al Anshari] ha parlato the pausa nella rivelazione, as the Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, ha raccontato: 'Mentre camminavo Ho sentito a voce dal cielo, ho guardato verso di essa and era the Angel che era venuto da me in the grotta di Hira, seduto su una sedia tra cielo e terra. ho avuto paura and sono tornato a casa, and ha detto: 'Coprimi. Coprimi.' Then Allah l'Altissimo ha fatto scendere la rivelazione: (O you who are avvolto) until the words of Allah (and abbandonate gli idoli). Da allora rivelazione è continuata senza interruzione.' This hadith was anche narrato by [Abdullah bin Yusuf] and [Abu Shalih], and also by [Hilal bin Raddad] from [Az Zuhri]. And [Yunus] ha detto; and [Ma'mar] erano d'accordo that l'ha ottenuto da Az Zuhri."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍفِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى{ لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ }قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُعَالِجُ مِنْ التَّنْزِيلِ شِدَّةً وَكَانَ مِمَّا يُحَرِّكُ شَفَتَيْهِ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَأَنَا أُحَرِّكُهُمَا لَكُمْ كَمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُحَرِّكُهُمَا وَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ أَنَا أُحَرِّكُهُمَا كَمَا رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يُحَرِّكُهُمَا فَحَرَّكَ شَفَتَيْهِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى{ لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ }قَالَ جَمْعُهُ لَكَ فِي صَدْرِكَ وَتَقْرَأَهُ{ فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ }قَالَ فَاسْتَمِعْ لَهُ وَأَنْصِتْ{ ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ }ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا أَنْ تَقْرَأَهُ فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ اسْتَمَعَ فَإِذَا انْطَلَقَ جِبْرِيلُ قَرَأَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَمَا قَرَأَهُ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Musa bin Isma'il] dia berkata, Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abu 'Awanah] berkata, bahwa Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Musa bin Abu Aisyah] berkata, Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Sa'id bin Jubair] dari [Ibnu 'Abbas] tentang firman Allah Ta'ala: (Janganlah kamu gerakkan lidahmu untuk (membaca) Al Quran karena hendak cepat-cepat ingin (menguasainya)." Berkata Ibnu 'Abbas: "Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam sangat kuat keinginannya untuk menghafalkan apa yang diturunkan (Al Qur'an) dan menggerak-gerakkan kedua bibir Beliau." Berkata Ibnu 'Abbas: "aku akan menggerakkan kedua bibirku (untuk membacakannya) kepada kalian sebagaimana Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam melakukannya kepadaku". Berkata Sa'id: "Dan aku akan menggerakkan kedua bibirku (untuk membacakannya) kepada kalian sebagaimana aku melihat Ibnu 'Abbas melakukannya. Maka Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam menggerakkan kedua bibirnya, Kemudian turunlah firman Allah Ta'ala: Janganlah kamu gerakkan lidahmu untuk (membaca) Al Quran karena hendak cepat-cepat (menguasai) nya. Sesungguhnya atas tanggungan Kamilah mengumpulkannya (di dadamu) dan (membuatmu pandai) membacanya". Maksudnya Allah mengumpulkannya di dalam dadamu (untuk dihafalkan) dan kemudian kamu membacanya: "Apabila Kami telah selesai membacakannya, maka ikutilah bacaannya itu". Maksudnya: "Dengarkanlah dan diamlah". Kemudian Allah Ta'ala berfirman: "Kemudian, sesungguhnya atas tanggungan Kamilah penjelasannya. Maksudnya: "Dan Kewajiban Kamilah untuk membacakannya" Dan Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam sejak saat itu bila Jibril 'Alaihis Salam datang kepadanya, Beliau mendengarkannya. Dan bila Jibril 'Alaihis Salam sudah pergi, maka Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam membacakannya (kepada para sahabat) sebagaimana Jibril 'Alaihis Salam membacakannya kepada Beliau shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Musa bin Isma'il], he said, narrated to us [Abu 'Awanah], who said that narrated to us [Musa bin Abu Aisyah], who said, narrated to us [Sa'id bin Jubair] from [Ibnu 'Abbas] about the words of Allah Ta'ala: (Do not move your tongue to (read) the Qur'an in order to hasten to (master) it). [Ibnu 'Abbas] said: "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, had a very strong desire to memorise what was sent down (the Qur'an) and moved his two lips." [Ibnu 'Abbas] said: "I will move my two lips (to recite it) to you as the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, did to me." [Sa'id] said: "And I will move my two lips (to recite it) to you as I saw [Ibnu 'Abbas] do it. Then the Prophet, peace be upon him, moved his two lips, then the words of Allah Ta'ala came down: Do not move your tongue to (read) the Qur'an in order to hasten to (master) it. Indeed it is upon Us to gather it (in your chest) and (make you able) to read it." Meaning: Allah gathers it in your chest (to be memorised) and then you read it: "When We have finished reciting it, then follow its recitation." Meaning: "Listen and be silent." Then Allah Ta'ala said: "Then indeed it is upon Us to explain it." Meaning: "And it is upon Us to recite it." And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, from then on, when Jibril, peace be upon him, came to him, he listened to him. And when Jibril, peace be upon him, had gone, then the Prophet, peace be upon him, recited it (to the companions) as Jibril, peace be upon him, had recited it to him, peace be upon him.
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Musa bin Isma'il], 彼は言った, 私たちに語った [Abu 'Awanah], who 言った that 私たちに語った [Musa bin Abu Aisyah], who 言った, 私たちに語った [Sa'id bin Jubair] from [Ibnu 'Abbas] 〜の言葉について of 至高のアッラー: (あなたの舌を動かすな to (read) the Qur'an in order 急ぐために to (習得する) it). [Ibnu 'Abbas] 言った: "The アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, had a とても強い望み to 暗記する 下されたもの (the Qur'an) and 両唇を動かした." [Ibnu 'Abbas] 言った: "私は両唇を動かすだろう (to 朗読する it) to you as the アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, did to me." [Sa'id] 言った: "And 私は両唇を動かすだろう (to 朗読する it) to you 私が見たように [Ibnu 'Abbas] do it. Then 預言者（彼に平安あれ）, 両唇を動かした, then the words of 至高のアッラー 降りてきた: あなたの舌を動かすな to (read) the Qur'an in order 急ぐために to (習得する) it. まさにそれは私たちにかかっている それを集めること (あなたの胸に) and (make you able) to read it." Meaning: Allah gathers it あなたの胸に (暗記されるために) and then you read it: "私たちがそれを朗読し終えたら, それからその朗読に従え." Meaning: "聞いて黙れ." Then 至高のアッラー 言った: "Then indeed それを説明することは私たちにかかっている." Meaning: "And それを朗読することは私たちにかかっている." And the アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, それ以来, when Jibril, peace be upon him, came to him, 彼は彼に耳を傾けた. And when Jibril, peace be upon him, had gone, then 預言者（彼に平安あれ）, それを朗読した (仲間たちに) as Jibril, peace be upon him, had それを朗読した to him, peace be upon him.
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Musa bin Isma'il], he 말했다, 우리에게 전했다 [Abu 'Awanah], who 말했다 that 우리에게 전했다 [Musa bin Abu Aisyah], who 말했다, 우리에게 전했다 [Sa'id bin Jubair] from [Ibnu 'Abbas] 말씀에 대해 of 지존하신 알라: (네 혀를 움직이지 말라 to (read) the Qur'an in order 서두르기 위해 to (터득하다) it). [Ibnu 'Abbas] 말했다: "The 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), had a 매우 강한 바람 to 암기하다 내려진 것 (the Qur'an) and 두 입술을 움직였다." [Ibnu 'Abbas] 말했다: "나는 두 입술을 움직일 것이다 (to 낭송하다 it) to you as the 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), did to me." [Sa'id] 말했다: "And 나는 두 입술을 움직일 것이다 (to 낭송하다 it) to you 내가 본 대로 [Ibnu 'Abbas] do it. 그러자 예언자는, peace be upon him, 두 입술을 움직였다, then the words of 지존하신 알라 내려왔다: 네 혀를 움직이지 말라 to (read) the Qur'an in order 서두르기 위해 to (터득하다) it. 참으로 그것은 우리에게 달려 있다 그것을 모으는 것 (네 가슴에) and (make you able) to read it." Meaning: Allah gathers it 네 가슴에 (암기되도록) and then you read it: "우리가 그것을 낭송을 마쳤을 때, 그 낭송을 따르라." Meaning: "듣고 조용히 하라." Then 지존하신 알라 말했다: "Then indeed 그것을 설명하는 것은 우리에게 달려 있다." Meaning: "And 그것을 낭송하는 것은 우리에게 달려 있다." And the 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), 그때부터, when Jibril, peace be upon him, came to him, 그는 그에게 귀 기울였다. And when Jibril, peace be upon him, had gone, 그러자 예언자는, peace be upon him, 그것을 낭송했다 (동료들에게) as Jibril, peace be upon him, had 그것을 낭송했다 to him, peace be upon him.
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Musa bin Isma'il], he 说, 向我们讲述 [Abu 'Awanah], who 说 that 向我们讲述 [Musa bin Abu Aisyah], who 说, 向我们讲述 [Sa'id bin Jubair] from [Ibnu 'Abbas] 关于安拉的话 of 至高的安拉: (不要动你的舌头 to (read) the Qur'an in order 为了急于 to (掌握) it). [Ibnu 'Abbas] 说: "The 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, had a 非常强烈的愿望 to 背记 所降下的 (the Qur'an) and 动了动双唇." [Ibnu 'Abbas] 说: "我会动一动双唇 (to 诵读 it) to you as the 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, did to me." [Sa'id] 说: "And 我会动一动双唇 (to 诵读 it) to you 正如我所见 [Ibnu 'Abbas] do it. 然后先知, peace be upon him, 动了动双唇, then the words of 至高的安拉 降下了: 不要动你的舌头 to (read) the Qur'an in order 为了急于 to (掌握) it. 这确实是我们的责任 集合它 (在你的胸中) and (make you able) to read it." Meaning: Allah gathers it 在你的胸中 (以便背记) and then you read it: "当我们诵读完它时, 你就跟随它的诵读." Meaning: "听着并保持安静." Then 至高的安拉 说: "Then indeed 解释它是我们的责任." Meaning: "And 诵读它是我们的责任." And the 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, 从那时起, when Jibril, peace be upon him, came to him, 他就听他诵读. And when Jibril, peace be upon him, had gone, 然后先知, peace be upon him, 他就诵读它 (给同伴们) as Jibril, peace be upon him, had 他就诵读它 to him, peace be upon him.
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Musa bin Isma'il], he a dit, Nous a raconté [Abu 'Awanah], who a dit that Nous a raconté [Musa bin Abu Aisyah], who a dit, Nous a raconté [Sa'id bin Jubair] from [Ibnu 'Abbas] au sujet des paroles of Allah Très-Haut: (Ne remue pas ta langue to (read) the Qur'an in order pour te hâter to (maîtriser) it). [Ibnu 'Abbas] a dit: "The Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, had a très fort désir to mémoriser ce qui a été descendu (the Qur'an) and a remué ses deux lèvres." [Ibnu 'Abbas] a dit: "je remuerai mes deux lèvres (to réciter it) to you as the Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, did to me." [Sa'id] a dit: "And je remuerai mes deux lèvres (to réciter it) to you comme je l'ai vu [Ibnu 'Abbas] do it. Alors le Prophète, peace be upon him, a remué ses deux lèvres, then the words of Allah Très-Haut est descendu: Ne remue pas ta langue to (read) the Qur'an in order pour te hâter to (maîtriser) it. C'est bien à Nous de le rassembler (dans ta poitrine) and (make you able) to read it." Meaning: Allah gathers it dans ta poitrine (pour être mémorisé) and then you read it: "Quand Nous aurons terminé de le réciter, suis alors sa récitation." Meaning: "Écoute et tais-toi." Then Allah Très-Haut a dit: "Then indeed c'est à Nous de l'expliquer." Meaning: "And c'est à Nous de le réciter." And the Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, dès lors, when Jibril, peace be upon him, came to him, il l'écoutait. And when Jibril, peace be upon him, had gone, Alors le Prophète, peace be upon him, il le récitait (aux compagnons) as Jibril, peace be upon him, had il le récitait to him, peace be upon him.
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Musa bin Isma'il], he sagte, Hat uns erzählt [Abu 'Awanah], who sagte that Hat uns erzählt [Musa bin Abu Aisyah], who sagte, Hat uns erzählt [Sa'id bin Jubair] from [Ibnu 'Abbas] über die Worte of Allah, der Erhabene: (Bewege deine Zunge nicht to (read) the Qur'an in order um zu eilen to (beherrschen) it). [Ibnu 'Abbas] sagte: "The Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, had a sehr starker Wunsch to auswendig lernen was herabgesandt wurde (the Qur'an) and bewegte seine beiden Lippen." [Ibnu 'Abbas] sagte: "ich werde meine beiden Lippen bewegen (to rezitieren it) to you as the Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, did to me." [Sa'id] sagte: "And ich werde meine beiden Lippen bewegen (to rezitieren it) to you wie ich sah [Ibnu 'Abbas] do it. Dann bewegte der Prophet, peace be upon him, bewegte seine beiden Lippen, then the words of Allah, der Erhabene kam herab: Bewege deine Zunge nicht to (read) the Qur'an in order um zu eilen to (beherrschen) it. Wahrlich, es obliegt Uns es zu sammeln (in deiner Brust) and (make you able) to read it." Meaning: Allah gathers it in deiner Brust (um auswendig gelernt zu werden) and then you read it: "Wenn Wir es zu Ende rezitiert haben, folge dann seiner Rezitation." Meaning: "Höre zu und schweige." Then Allah, der Erhabene sagte: "Then indeed es obliegt Uns, es zu erklären." Meaning: "And es obliegt Uns, es zu rezitieren." And the Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, von da an, when Jibril, peace be upon him, came to him, hörte er ihm zu. And when Jibril, peace be upon him, had gone, Dann bewegte der Prophet, peace be upon him, rezitierte er es (den Gefährten) as Jibril, peace be upon him, had rezitierte er es to him, peace be upon him.
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Musa bin Isma'il], he ha detto, Ci ha narrato [Abu 'Awanah], who ha detto that Ci ha narrato [Musa bin Abu Aisyah], who ha detto, Ci ha narrato [Sa'id bin Jubair] from [Ibnu 'Abbas] sulle parole of Allah l'Altissimo: (Non muovere la tua lingua to (read) the Qur'an in order per affrettarti to (padroneggiare) it). [Ibnu 'Abbas] ha detto: "The Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, had a desiderio molto forte to memorizzare ciò che è stato fatto scendere (the Qur'an) and ha mosso le sue due labbra." [Ibnu 'Abbas] ha detto: "muoverò le mie due labbra (to recitare it) to you as the Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, did to me." [Sa'id] ha detto: "And muoverò le mie due labbra (to recitare it) to you come ho visto [Ibnu 'Abbas] do it. Allora il Profeta, peace be upon him, ha mosso le sue due labbra, then the words of Allah l'Altissimo è sceso: Non muovere la tua lingua to (read) the Qur'an in order per affrettarti to (padroneggiare) it. In verità spetta a Noi raccoglierlo (nel tuo petto) and (make you able) to read it." Meaning: Allah gathers it nel tuo petto (per essere memorizzato) and then you read it: "Quando avremo finito di recitarlo, segui allora la sua recitazione." Meaning: "Ascolta e taci." Then Allah l'Altissimo ha detto: "Then indeed spetta a Noi spiegarlo." Meaning: "And spetta a Noi recitarlo." And the Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, da allora, when Jibril, peace be upon him, came to him, lo ascoltava. And when Jibril, peace be upon him, had gone, Allora il Profeta, peace be upon him, lo recitava (ai compagni) as Jibril, peace be upon him, had lo recitava to him, peace be upon him.

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ ح و حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ وَمَعْمَرٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ نَحْوَهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَجْوَدَ النَّاسِ وَكَانَ أَجْوَدُ مَا يَكُونُ فِي رَمَضَانَ حِينَ يَلْقَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ وَكَانَ يَلْقَاهُ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فَيُدَارِسُهُ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَجْوَدُ بِالْخَيْرِ مِنْ الرِّيحِ الْمُرْسَلَةِ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abdan] dia berkata, telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Abdullah] telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Yunus] dari [Az Zuhri] dan dengan riwayat yang sama, telah menceritakan pula kepada kami [Bisyir bin Muhammad] berkata, telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Abdullah] berkata, telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Yunus] dan [Ma'mar] dari [Az Zuhri] seperti lainnya berkata, telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah] dari [Ibnu 'Abbas] berkata, bahwa Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam adalah manusia yang paling lembut terutama pada bulan Ramadlan ketika malaikat Jibril 'Alaihis Salam menemuinya, dan adalah Jibril 'Alaihis Salam mendatanginya setiap malam di bulan Ramadlan, dimana Jibril 'Alaihis Salam mengajarkan Al Qur'an. Sungguh Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam jauh lebih lembut daripada angin yang berhembus.
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Abdan], he said, informed us [Abdullah], informed us [Yunus] from [Az Zuhri], and with the same chain, narrated also to us [Bisyir bin Muhammad], who said, informed us [Abdullah], who said, informed us [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri], as others said, informed us [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah] from [Ibnu 'Abbas], who said that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was the gentlest of people, especially in the month of Ramadhan when the angel Jibril, peace be upon him, met him, and Jibril, peace be upon him, would come to him every night in the month of Ramadhan, when Jibril, peace be upon him, taught him the Qur'an. Indeed the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was far gentler than the blowing wind.
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Abdan], 彼は言った, 私たちに伝えた [Abdullah], 私たちに伝えた [Yunus] from [Az Zuhri], and 同じ連鎖で, 伝えられた also to us [Bisyir bin Muhammad], who 言った, 私たちに伝えた [Abdullah], who 言った, 私たちに伝えた [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri], 他の者たちが言ったように, 私たちに伝えた [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah] from [Ibnu 'Abbas], who 言った that the アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, 人々の中で最も優しい者だった, 特にラマダーンの月に when the angel Jibril, peace be upon him, 会った him, and Jibril, peace be upon him, 毎晩彼のところに来た in the month of Ramadhan, when Jibril, peace be upon him, 彼にクルアーンを教えた. Indeed the アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, was はるかに優しい 吹く風よりも.
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Abdan], he 말했다, informed us [Abdullah], informed us [Yunus] from [Az Zuhri], and 같은 전승 계보로, 전해졌다 also to us [Bisyir bin Muhammad], who 말했다, informed us [Abdullah], who 말했다, informed us [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri], 다른 이들이 말한 대로, informed us [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah] from [Ibnu 'Abbas], who 말했다 that the 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), 사람들 중 가장 부드러웠다, 특히 라마단 달에 when the angel Jibril, peace be upon him, 만났다 him, and Jibril, peace be upon him, 매일 밤 그에게 왔다 in the month of Ramadhan, when Jibril, peace be upon him, 그에게 꾸란을 가르쳤다. Indeed the 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), was 훨씬 더 부드러웠다 부는 바람보다.
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Abdan], he 说, informed us [Abdullah], informed us [Yunus] from [Az Zuhri], and 以同样的传述系统, 传述 also to us [Bisyir bin Muhammad], who 说, informed us [Abdullah], who 说, informed us [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri], 正如其他人所说, informed us [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah] from [Ibnu 'Abbas], who 说 that the 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, 是人们中最温和的, 尤其在斋月 when the angel Jibril, peace be upon him, 去见 him, and Jibril, peace be upon him, 每夜都来到他跟前 in the month of Ramadhan, when Jibril, peace be upon him, 教他古兰经. Indeed the 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, was 温和得多 比吹拂的风.
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Abdan], he a dit, informed us [Abdullah], informed us [Yunus] from [Az Zuhri], and avec la même chaîne, rapporté also to us [Bisyir bin Muhammad], who a dit, informed us [Abdullah], who a dit, informed us [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri], comme d'autres l'ont dit, informed us [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah] from [Ibnu 'Abbas], who a dit that the Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, était le plus doux des gens, surtout au mois de Ramadhan when the angel Jibril, peace be upon him, a rencontré him, and Jibril, peace be upon him, venait à lui chaque nuit in the month of Ramadhan, when Jibril, peace be upon him, lui enseignait le Coran. Indeed the Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, was bien plus doux que le vent qui souffle.
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Abdan], he sagte, informed us [Abdullah], informed us [Yunus] from [Az Zuhri], and mit derselben Kette, überliefert also to us [Bisyir bin Muhammad], who sagte, informed us [Abdullah], who sagte, informed us [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri], wie andere sagten, informed us [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah] from [Ibnu 'Abbas], who sagte that the Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, Krieg der sanftmütigste der Menschen, besonders im Monat Ramadan when the angel Jibril, peace be upon him, traf him, and Jibril, peace be upon him, kam jede Nacht zu ihm in the month of Ramadhan, when Jibril, peace be upon him, lehrte ihn den Koran. Indeed the Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, was weit sanftmütiger als der wehende Wind.
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Abdan], he ha detto, informed us [Abdullah], informed us [Yunus] from [Az Zuhri], and con la stessa catena, narrato also to us [Bisyir bin Muhammad], who ha detto, informed us [Abdullah], who ha detto, informed us [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri], come altri hanno detto, informed us [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah] from [Ibnu 'Abbas], who ha detto that the Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, era il più mite tra la gente, soprattutto nel mese di Ramadhan when the angel Jibril, peace be upon him, ha incontrato him, and Jibril, peace be upon him, veniva da lui ogni notte in the month of Ramadhan, when Jibril, peace be upon him, gli insegnava il Corano. Indeed the Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, was molto più mite del vento che soffia.

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ بْنَ حَرْبٍ أَخْبَرَهُأَنَّ هِرَقْلَ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ فِي رَكْبٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ وَكَانُوا تِجَارًا بِالشَّأْمِ فِي الْمُدَّةِ الَّتِي كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَادَّ فِيهَا أَبَا سُفْيَانَ وَكُفَّارَ قُرَيْشٍ فَأَتَوْهُ وَهُمْ بِإِيلِيَاءَ فَدَعَاهُمْ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ وَحَوْلَهُ عُظَمَاءُ الرُّومِ ثُمَّ دَعَاهُمْ وَدَعَا بِتَرْجُمَانِهِ فَقَالَ أَيُّكُمْ أَقْرَبُ نَسَبًا بِهَذَا الرَّجُلِ الَّذِي يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ نَبِيٌّ فَقَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا أَقْرَبُهُمْ نَسَبًا فَقَالَ أَدْنُوهُ مِنِّي وَقَرِّبُوا أَصْحَابَهُ فَاجْعَلُوهُمْ عِنْدَ ظَهْرِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِتَرْجُمَانِهِ قُلْ لَهُمْ إِنِّي سَائِلٌ هَذَا عَنْ هَذَا الرَّجُلِ فَإِنْ كَذَبَنِي فَكَذِّبُوهُ فَوَاللَّهِ لَوْلَا الْحَيَاءُ مِنْ أَنْ يَأْثِرُوا عَلَيَّ كَذِبًا لَكَذَبْتُ عَنْهُ ثُمَّ كَانَ أَوَّلَ مَا سَأَلَنِي عَنْهُ أَنْ قَالَ كَيْفَ نَسَبُهُ فِيكُمْ قُلْتُ هُوَ فِينَا ذُو نَسَبٍ قَالَ فَهَلْ قَالَ هَذَا الْقَوْلَ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ قَطُّ قَبْلَهُ قُلْتُ لَا قَالَ فَهَلْ كَانَ مِنْ آبَائِهِ مِنْ مَلِكٍ قُلْتُ لَا قَالَ فَأَشْرَافُ النَّاسِ يَتَّبِعُونَهُ أَمْ ضُعَفَاؤُهُمْ فَقُلْتُ بَلْ ضُعَفَاؤُهُمْ قَالَ أَيَزِيدُونَ أَمْ يَنْقُصُونَ قُلْتُ بَلْ يَزِيدُونَ قَالَ فَهَلْ يَرْتَدُّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ سَخْطَةً لِدِينِهِ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ فِيهِ قُلْتُ لَا قَالَ فَهَلْ كُنْتُمْ تَتَّهِمُونَهُ بِالْكَذِبِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَ مَا قَالَ قُلْتُ لَا قَالَ فَهَلْ يَغْدِرُ قُلْتُ لَا وَنَحْنُ مِنْهُ فِي مُدَّةٍ لَا نَدْرِي مَا هُوَ فَاعِلٌ فِيهَا قَالَ وَلَمْ تُمْكِنِّي كَلِمَةٌ أُدْخِلُ فِيهَا شَيْئًا غَيْرُ هَذِهِ الْكَلِمَةِ قَالَ فَهَلْ قَاتَلْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ قِتَالُكُمْ إِيَّاهُ قُلْتُ الْحَرْبُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ سِجَالٌ يَنَالُ مِنَّا وَنَنَالُ مِنْهُ قَالَ مَاذَا يَأْمُرُكُمْ قُلْتُ يَقُولُ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَحْدَهُ وَلَا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا وَاتْرُكُوا مَا يَقُولُ آبَاؤُكُمْ وَيَأْمُرُنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَاةِ وَالصِّدْقِ وَالْعَفَافِ وَالصِّلَةِ فَقَالَ لِلتَّرْجُمَانِ قُلْ لَهُ سَأَلْتُكَ عَنْ نَسَبِهِ فَذَكَرْتَ أَنَّهُ فِيكُمْ ذُو نَسَبٍ فَكَذَلِكَ الرُّسُلُ تُبْعَثُ فِي نَسَبِ قَوْمِهَا وَسَأَلْتُكَ هَلْ قَالَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ هَذَا الْقَوْلَ فَذَكَرْتَ أَنْ لَا فَقُلْتُ لَوْ كَانَ أَحَدٌ قَالَ هَذَا الْقَوْلَ قَبْلَهُ لَقُلْتُ رَجُلٌ يَأْتَسِي بِقَوْلٍ قِيلَ قَبْلَهُ وَسَأَلْتُكَ هَلْ كَانَ مِنْ آبَائِهِ مِنْ مَلِكٍ فَذَكَرْتَ أَنْ لَا قُلْتُ فَلَوْ كَانَ مِنْ آبَائِهِ مِنْ مَلِكٍ قُلْتُ رَجُلٌ يَطْلُبُ مُلْكَ أَبِيهِ وَسَأَلْتُكَ هَلْ كُنْتُمْ تَتَّهِمُونَهُ بِالْكَذِبِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَ مَا قَالَ فَذَكَرْتَ أَنْ لَا فَقَدْ أَعْرِفُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِيَذَرَ الْكَذِبَ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَيَكْذِبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَسَأَلْتُكَ أَشْرَافُ النَّاسِ اتَّبَعُوهُ أَمْ ضُعَفَاؤُهُمْ فَذَكَرْتَ أَنَّ ضُعَفَاءَهُمْ اتَّبَعُوهُ وَهُمْ أَتْبَاعُ الرُّسُلِ وَسَأَلْتُكَ أَيَزِيدُونَ أَمْ يَنْقُصُونَ فَذَكَرْتَ أَنَّهُمْ يَزِيدُونَ وَكَذَلِكَ أَمْرُ الْإِيمَانِ حَتَّى يَتِمَّ وَسَأَلْتُكَ أَيَرْتَدُّ أَحَدٌ سَخْطَةً لِدِينِهِ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ فِيهِ فَذَكَرْتَ أَنْ لَا وَكَذَلِكَ الْإِيمَانُ حِينَ تُخَالِطُ بَشَاشَتُهُ الْقُلُوبَ وَسَأَلْتُكَ هَلْ يَغْدِرُ فَذَكَرْتَ أَنْ لَا وَكَذَلِكَ الرُّسُلُ لَا تَغْدِرُ وَسَأَلْتُكَ بِمَا يَأْمُرُكُمْ فَذَكَرْتَ أَنَّهُ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَنْ تَعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا وَيَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْ عِبَادَةِ الْأَوْثَانِ وَيَأْمُرُكُمْ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالصِّدْقِ وَالْعَفَافِ فَإِنْ كَانَ مَا تَقُولُ حَقًّا فَسَيَمْلِكُ مَوْضِعَ قَدَمَيَّ هَاتَيْنِ وَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ خَارِجٌ لَمْ أَكُنْ أَظُنُّ أَنَّهُ مِنْكُمْ فَلَوْ أَنِّي أَعْلَمُ أَنِّي أَخْلُصُ إِلَيْهِ لَتَجَشَّمْتُ لِقَاءَهُ وَلَوْ كُنْتُ عِنْدَهُ لَغَسَلْتُ عَنْ قَدَمِهِ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِكِتَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الَّذِي بَعَثَ بِهِ دِحْيَةُ إِلَى عَظِيمِ بُصْرَى فَدَفَعَهُ إِلَى هِرَقْلَ فَقَرَأَهُ فَإِذَا فِيهِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى هِرَقْلَ عَظِيمِ الرُّومِ سَلَامٌ عَلَى مَنْ اتَّبَعَ الْهُدَى أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنِّي أَدْعُوكَ بِدِعَايَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ أَسْلِمْ تَسْلَمْ يُؤْتِكَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ مَرَّتَيْنِ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ إِثْمَ الْأَرِيسِيِّينَ وَ{ يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ تَعَالَوْا إِلَى كَلِمَةٍ سَوَاءٍ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَنْ لَا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُولُوا اشْهَدُوا بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ }قَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَلَمَّا قَالَ مَا قَالَ وَفَرَغَ مِنْ قِرَاءَةِ الْكِتَابِ كَثُرَ عِنْدَهُ الصَّخَبُ وَارْتَفَعَتْ الْأَصْوَاتُ وَأُخْرِجْنَا فَقُلْتُ لِأَصْحَابِي حِينَ أُخْرِجْنَا لَقَدْ أَمِرَ أَمْرُ ابْنِ أَبِي كَبْشَةَ إِنَّهُ يَخَافُهُ مَلِكُ بَنِي الْأَصْفَرِ فَمَا زِلْتُ مُوقِنًا أَنَّهُ سَيَظْهَرُ حَتَّى أَدْخَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ الْإِسْلَامَ وَكَانَ ابْنُ النَّاظُورِ صَاحِبُ إِيلِيَاءَ وَهِرَقْلَ سُقُفًّا عَلَى نَصَارَى الشَّأْمِ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ هِرَقْلَ حِينَ قَدِمَ إِيلِيَاءَ أَصْبَحَ يَوْمًا خَبِيثَ النَّفْسِ فَقَالَ بَعْضُ بَطَارِقَتِهِ قَدْ اسْتَنْكَرْنَا هَيْئَتَكَ قَالَ ابْنُ النَّاظُورِ وَكَانَ هِرَقْلُ حَزَّاءً يَنْظُرُ فِي النُّجُومِ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ حِينَ سَأَلُوهُ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ اللَّيْلَةَ حِينَ نَظَرْتُ فِي النُّجُومِ مَلِكَ الْخِتَانِ قَدْ ظَهَرَ فَمَنْ يَخْتَتِنُ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ قَالُوا لَيْسَ يَخْتَتِنُ إِلَّا الْيَهُودُ فَلَا يُهِمَّنَّكَ شَأْنُهُمْ وَاكْتُبْ إِلَى مَدَايِنِ مُلْكِكَ فَيَقْتُلُوا مَنْ فِيهِمْ مِنْ الْيَهُودِ فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ عَلَى أَمْرِهِمْ أُتِيَ هِرَقْلُ بِرَجُلٍ أَرْسَلَ بِهِ مَلِكُ غَسَّانَ يُخْبِرُ عَنْ خَبَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَلَمَّا اسْتَخْبَرَهُ هِرَقْلُ قَالَ اذْهَبُوا فَانْظُرُوا أَمُخْتَتِنٌ هُوَ أَمْ لَا فَنَظَرُوا إِلَيْهِ فَحَدَّثُوهُ أَنَّهُ مُخْتَتِنٌ وَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ الْعَرَبِ فَقَالَ هُمْ يَخْتَتِنُونَ فَقَالَ هِرَقْلُ هَذَا مُلْكُ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ قَدْ ظَهَرَ ثُمَّ كَتَبَ هِرَقْلُ إِلَى صَاحِبٍ لَهُ بِرُومِيَةَ وَكَانَ نَظِيرَهُ فِي الْعِلْمِ وَسَارَ هِرَقْلُ إِلَى حِمْصَ فَلَمْ يَرِمْ حِمْصَ حَتَّى أَتَاهُ كِتَابٌ مِنْ صَاحِبِهِ يُوَافِقُ رَأْيَ هِرَقْلَ عَلَى خُرُوجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنَّهُ نَبِيٌّ فَأَذِنَ هِرَقْلُ لِعُظَمَاءِ الرُّومِ فِي دَسْكَرَةٍ لَهُ بِحِمْصَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِأَبْوَابِهَا فَغُلِّقَتْ ثُمَّ اطَّلَعَ فَقَالَ يَا مَعْشَرَ الرُّومِ هَلْ لَكُمْ فِي الْفَلَاحِ وَالرُّشْدِ وَأَنْ يَثْبُتَ مُلْكُكُمْ فَتُبَايِعُوا هَذَا النَّبِيَّ فَحَاصُوا حَيْصَةَ حُمُرِ الْوَحْشِ إِلَى الْأَبْوَابِ فَوَجَدُوهَا قَدْ غُلِّقَتْ فَلَمَّا رَأَى هِرَقْلُ نَفْرَتَهُمْ وَأَيِسَ مِنْ الْإِيمَانِ قَالَ رُدُّوهُمْ عَلَيَّ وَقَالَ إِنِّي قُلْتُ مَقَالَتِي آنِفًا أَخْتَبِرُ بِهَا شِدَّتَكُمْ عَلَى دِينِكُمْ فَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ فَسَجَدُوا لَهُ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ فَكَانَ ذَلِكَ آخِرَ شَأْنِ هِرَقْلَرَوَاهُ صَالِحُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ وَيُونُسُ وَمَعْمَرٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abu Al Yaman Al Hakam bin Nafi'] dia berkata, telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Syu'aib] dari [Az Zuhri] telah mengabarkan kepadaku [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin 'Utbah bin Mas'ud] bahwa [Abdullah bin 'Abbas] telah mengabarkan kepadanya bahwa [Abu Sufyan bin Harb] telah mengabarkan kepadanya; bahwa Heraclius menerima rombongan dagang Quraisy, yang sedang mengadakan ekspedisi dagang ke Negeri Syam pada saat berlakunya perjanjian antara Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam dengan Abu Sufyan dan orang-orang kafir Quraisy. Saat singgah di Iliya' mereka menemui Heraclius atas undangan Heraclius untuk di diajak dialog di majelisnya, yang saat itu Heraclius bersama dengan para pembesar-pembesar Negeri Romawi. Heraclius berbicara dengan mereka melalui penerjemah. Heraclius berkata; "Siapa diantara kalian yang paling dekat hubungan keluarganya dengan orang yang mengaku sebagai Nabi itu?." Abu Sufyan berkata; maka aku menjawab; "Akulah yang paling dekat hubungan kekeluargaannya dengan dia". Heraclius berkata; "Dekatkanlah dia denganku dan juga sahabat-sahabatnya." Maka mereka meletakkan orang-orang Quraisy berada di belakang Abu Sufyan. Lalu Heraclius berkata melalui penerjemahnya: "Katakan kepadanya, bahwa aku bertanya kepadanya tentang lelaki yang mengaku sebagai Nabi. Jika ia berdusta kepadaku maka kalian harus mendustakannya."Demi Allah, kalau bukan rasa malu akibat tudingan pendusta yang akan mereka lontarkan kepadaku niscaya aku berdusta kepadanya." Abu Sufyan berkata; Maka yang pertama ditanyakannya kepadaku tentangnya (Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam) adalah: "bagaimana kedudukan nasabnya ditengah-tengah kalian?" Aku jawab: "Dia adalah dari keturunan baik-baik (bangsawan) ". Tanyanya lagi: "Apakah ada orang lain yang pernah mengatakannya sebelum dia?" Aku jawab: "Tidak ada". Tanyanya lagi: "Apakah bapaknya seorang raja?" Jawabku: "Bukan". Apakah yang mengikuti dia orang-orang yang terpandang atau orang-orang yang rendah?" Jawabku: "Bahkan yang mengikutinya adalah orang-orang yang rendah". Dia bertanya lagi: "Apakah bertambah pengikutnya atau berkurang?" Aku jawab: "Bertambah". Dia bertanya lagi: "Apakah ada yang murtad disebabkan dongkol terhadap agamanya?" Aku jawab: "Tidak ada". Dia bertanya lagi: "Apakah kalian pernah mendapatkannya dia berdusta sebelum dia menyampaikan apa yang dikatakannya itu?" Aku jawab: "Tidak pernah". Dia bertanya lagi: "Apakah dia pernah berlaku curang?" Aku jawab: "Tidak pernah. Ketika kami bergaul dengannya, dia tidak pernah melakukan itu". Berkata Abu Sufyan: "Aku tidak mungkin menyampaikan selain ucapan seperti ini". Dia bertanya lagi: "Apakah kalian memeranginya?" Aku jawab: "Iya". Dia bertanya lagi: "Bagaimana kesudahan perang tersebut?" Aku jawab: "Perang antara kami dan dia sangat banyak. Terkadang dia mengalahkan kami terkadang kami yang mengalahkan dia". Dia bertanya lagi: "Apa yang diperintahkannya kepada kalian?" Aku jawab: "Dia menyuruh kami; 'Sembahlah Allah dengan tidak menyekutukannya dengan sesuatu apapun, dan tinggalkan apa yang dikatakan oleh nenek moyang kalian. ' Dia juga memerintahkan kami untuk menegakkan shalat, menunaikan zakat, berkata jujur, saling memaafkan dan menyambung silaturrahim". Maka Heraclius berkata kepada penerjemahnya: "Katakan kepadanya, bahwa aku telah bertanya kepadamu tentang keturunan orang itu, kamu ceritakan bahwa orang itu dari keturunan bangsawan. Begitu juga laki-laki itu dibangkitkan di tengah keturunan kaumnya. Dan aku tanya kepadamu apakah pernah ada orang sebelumnya yang mengatakan seperti yang dikatakannya, kamu jawab tidak. Seandainya dikatakan ada orang sebelumnya yang mengatakannya tentu kuanggap orang ini meniru orang sebelumnya yang pernah mengatakan hal serupa. Aku tanyakan juga kepadamu apakah bapaknya ada yang dari keturunan raja, maka kamu jawab tidak. Aku katakan seandainya bapaknya dari keturunan raja, tentu orang ini sedang menuntut kerajaan bapaknya. Dan aku tanyakan juga kepadamu apakah kalian pernah mendapatkan dia berdusta sebelum dia menyampaikan apa yang dikatakannya, kamu menjawabnya tidak. Sungguh aku memahami, kalau kepada manusia saja dia tidak berani berdusta apalagi berdusta kepada Allah. Dan aku juga telah bertanya kepadamu, apakah yang mengikuti dia orang-orang yang terpandang atau orang-orang yang rendah?" Kamu menjawab orang-orang yang rendah yang mengikutinya. Memang mereka itulah yang menjadi para pengikut Rasul. Aku juga sudah bertanya kepadamu apakah bertambah pengikutnya atau berkurang, kamu menjawabnya bertambah. Dan memang begitulah perkara iman hingga menjadi sempurna. Aku juga sudah bertanya kepadamu apakah ada yang murtad disebabkan marah terhadap agamanya. Kamu menjawab tidak ada. Dan memang begitulah iman bila telah masuk tumbuh bersemi di dalam hati. Aku juga sudah bertanya kepadamu apakah dia pernah berlaku curang, kamu jawab tidak pernah. Dan memang begitulah para Rasul tidak mungkin curang. Dan aku juga sudah bertanya kepadamu apa yang diperintahkannya kepada kalian, kamu jawab dia memerintahkan kalian untuk menyembah Allah dengan tidak menyekutukannya dengan sesuatu apapun, dan melarang kalian menyembah berhala, dia juga memerintahkan kalian untuk menegakkan shalat, menunaikan zakat, berkata jujur, saling memaafkan dan menyambung silaturrahim. Seandainya semua apa yang kamu katakan ini benar, pasti dia akan menguasai kerajaan yang ada di bawah kakiku ini. Sungguh aku telah menduga bahwa dia tidak ada diantara kalian sekarang ini, seandainya aku tahu jalan untuk bisa menemuinya, tentu aku akan berusaha keras menemuinya hingga bila aku sudah berada di sisinya pasti aku akan basuh kedua kakinya. Kemudian Heraclius meminta surat Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam yang dibawa oleh Dihyah untuk para Penguasa Negeri Bashrah, Maka diberikannya surat itu kepada Heraclius, maka dibacanya dan isinya berbunyi: "Bismillahir rahmanir rahim. Dari Muhammad, hamba Allah dan Rasul-Nya untuk Heraclius. Penguasa Romawi, Keselamatan bagi siapa yang mengikuti petunjuk. Kemudian daripada itu, aku mengajakmu dengan seruan Islam; masuk Islamlah kamu, maka kamu akan selamat, Allah akan memberi pahala kepadamu dua kali. Namun jika kamu berpaling, maka kamu menanggung dosa rakyat kamu, dan: Hai ahli kitab, marilah (berpegang) kepada suatu kalimat (ketetapan) yang tidak ada perselisihan antara kami dan kamu, bahwa tidak kita sembah kecuali Allah dan tidak kita persekutukan dia dengan sesuatupun dan tidak (pula) sebagian kita menjadikan sebagian yang lain sebagai Rabb selain Allah". Jika mereka berpaling, maka katakanlah kepada mereka: "Saksikanlah, bahwa kami adalah orang-orang yang berserah diri (kepada Allah)." Abu Sufyan menuturkan: "Setelah Heraclius menyampaikan apa yang dikatakannya dan selesai membaca surat tersebut, terjadilah hiruk pikuk dan suara-suara ribut, sehingga mengusir kami. Aku berkata kepada teman-temanku setelah kami diusir keluar; "sungguh dia telah diajak kepada urusan Anak Abu Kabsyah. Heraclius mengkhawatirkan kerajaan Romawi."Pada masa itupun aku juga khawatir bahwa Muhammad akan berjaya, sampai akhirnya (perasaan itu hilang setelah) Allah memasukkan aku ke dalam Islam. Dan adalah Ibnu An Nazhur, seorang Pembesar Iliya' dan Heraclius adalah seorang uskup agama Nashrani, dia menceritakan bahwa pada suatu hari ketika Heraclius mengunjungi Iliya' dia sangat gelisah, berkata sebagian komandan perangnya: "Sungguh kami mengingkari keadaanmu. Selanjutnya kata Ibnu Nazhhur, "Heraclius adalah seorang ahli nujum yang selalu memperhatikan perjalanan bintang-bintang. Dia pernah menjawab pertanyaan para pendeta yang bertanya kepadanya; "Pada suatu malam ketika saya mengamati perjalanan bintang-bintang, saya melihat raja Khitan telah lahir, siapakah di antara ummat ini yang di khitan?" Jawab para pendeta; "Yang berkhitan hanyalah orang-orang Yahudi, janganlah anda risau karena orang-orang Yahudi itu. Perintahkan saja keseluruh negeri dalam kerajaan anda, supaya orang-orang Yahudi di negeri tersebut di bunuh." Ketika itu di hadapakan kepada Heraclius seorang utusan raja Bani Ghasssan untuk menceritakan perihal Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam, setelah orang itu selesai bercerita, lalu Heraclius memerintahkan agar dia diperiksa, apakah dia berkhitan ataukah tidak. Seusai di periksa, ternyata memang dia berkhitam. Lalu di beritahukan orang kepada Heraclius. Heraclius bertanya kepada orang tersebut tentang orang-orang Arab yang lainnya, di khitankah mereka ataukah tidak?" Dia menjawab; "Orang Arab itu di khitan semuanya." Heraclius berkata; 'inilah raja ummat, sesungguhnya dia telah terlahir." Kemudian heraclisu berkirim surat kepada seorang sahabatnya di Roma yang ilmunya setarf dengan Heraclisu (untuk menceritakan perihal kelahiran Nabi Muhammad shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam). Sementara itu, ia meneruskan perjalanannya ke negeri Himsha, tetapi sebelum tiba di Himsha, balasan surat dari sahabatnya itu telah tiba terlebih dahulu. Sahabatnya itu menyetujui pendapat Heraclius bahwa Muhammad telah lahir dan bahwa beliau memang seorang Nabi. Heraclius lalu mengundang para pembesar Roma supaya datang ke tempatnya di Himsha, setelah semuanya hadir dalam majlisnya, Heraclius memerintahkan supaya mengunci semua pintu. Kemudian dia berkata; 'Wahai bangsa rum, maukah anda semua beroleh kemenangan dan kemajuan yang gilang gemilang, sedangkan kerajaan tetap utuh di tangan kita? Kalau mau, akuilah Muhammad sebagai Nabi!." Mendengar ucapan itu, mereka lari bagaikan keledai liar, padahal semua pintu telah terkunci. Melihat keadaan yang demikian, Heraclius jadi putus harapan yang mereka akan beriman (percaya kepada kenabian Muhammad). Lalu di perintahkannya semuanya untuk kembali ke tempatnya masing-masing seraya berkata; "Sesungguhnya saya mengucapkan perkataan saya tadi hanyalah sekedar menguji keteguhan hati anda semua. Kini saya telah melihat keteguhan itu." Lalu mereka sujud di hadapan Heraclius dan mereka senang kepadanya. Demikianlah akhir kisah Heraclius. Telah di riwayatkan oleh [Shalih bin Kaisan] dan [Yunus] dan [Ma'mar] dari [Az Zuhri].
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Abu Al Yaman Al Hakam bin Nafi'], he said, informed us [Syu'aib] from [Az Zuhri], [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin 'Utbah bin Mas'ud] informed me that [Abdullah bin 'Abbas] informed him that [Abu Sufyan bin Harb] informed him; that Heraclius received a Quraisy trade caravan that was on a trading expedition to the land of Syam at the time the treaty between the Prophet, peace be upon him, and Abu Sufyan and the disbelieving Quraisy was in force. When they stopped at Iliya', they met Heraclius at Heraclius' invitation to be invited to dialogue in his assembly, where Heraclius was then with the nobles of the land of Rome. Heraclius spoke with them through an interpreter. Heraclius said: "Who among you is closest in family ties to the man who claims to be a Prophet?" Abu Sufyan said: "So I answered: 'I am the closest in family ties to him.'" Heraclius said: "Bring him close to me and also his companions." So they placed the Quraisy people behind Abu Sufyan. Then Heraclius said through his interpreter: "Tell him that I am asking him about the man who claims to be a Prophet. If he lies to me, then you must call him a liar." By Allah, were it not for the shame of the accusation of lying that they would throw at me, I would certainly have lied to him. Abu Sufyan said: "Then the first thing he asked me about him (the Prophet, peace be upon him) was: 'What is his lineage among you?' I answered: 'He is of good (noble) lineage.' He asked again: 'Was there anyone else who said it before him?' I answered: 'There was none.' He asked again: 'Was his father a king?'
