I answered: 'No.' 'Do those who follow him consist of the notable people or the lowly people?' I answered: 'Rather those who follow him are the lowly people.' He asked again: 'Do his followers increase or decrease?' I answered: 'They increase.' He asked again: 'Is there anyone who apostatised out of hatred for his religion?' I answered: 'There is none.' He asked again: 'Did you ever find him lying before he conveyed what he said?' I answered: 'Never.' He asked again: 'Did he ever act treacherously?' I answered: 'Never. When we dealt with him, he never did that.' Abu Sufyan said: 'I could not say anything other than words like this.' He asked again: 'Did you fight him?' I answered: 'Yes.' He asked again: 'How did the war end?' I answered: 'The war between us and him was very frequent. Sometimes he defeated us, sometimes we defeated him.' He asked again: 'What does he command you?' I answered: 'He commands us: Worship Allah without associating anything with Him, and leave what your forefathers said. He also commands us to establish prayer, pay zakat, speak truthfully, forgive one another and join the ties of kinship.' Then Heraclius said to his interpreter: 'Tell him that I asked you about the lineage of that man; you told me that that man is of noble lineage. Likewise a man is raised among the lineage of his people. And I asked you whether anyone before him had said what he said; you answered no. If there had been someone before him who said it, I would certainly have considered this man to be imitating the one before him who had said something similar. I also asked you whether his father was of royal lineage; you answered no. I say, if his father had been of royal lineage, this man would certainly be seeking his father's kingdom. And I also asked you whether you had ever found him lying before he conveyed what he said; you answered no. Indeed I understand that if he does not dare to lie to people, still less would he lie to Allah. And I also asked you whether those who follow him are the notable people or the lowly people? You answered that the lowly people follow him. Indeed they are the ones who become the followers of the Messengers. I also asked you whether his followers increase or decrease; you answered they increase. And indeed that is how faith is, until it becomes perfect. I also asked you whether anyone apostatised out of anger at his religion. You answered there is none. And indeed that is how faith is when it has entered and grown in the heart. I also asked you whether he ever acted treacherously; you answered never. And indeed that is how the Messengers are: they cannot act treacherously. And I also asked you what he commands you; you answered that he commands you to worship Allah without associating anything with Him, and to forbid you from worshipping idols; he also commands you to establish prayer, pay zakat, speak truthfully, forgive one another and join the ties of kinship. If all that you say is true, he will surely rule the kingdom under my feet. Indeed I had suspected that he was not among you now; if I knew a way to reach him, I would certainly strive hard to meet him, so that when I was beside him I would wash his two feet. Then Heraclius asked for the letter of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, which Dihyah had brought for the rulers of the land of Bashrah; it was given to Heraclius, and he read it, and its contents were: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. From Muhammad, the servant of Allah and His Messenger, to Heraclius, ruler of Rome: Peace be upon whoever follows guidance. Furthermore, I invite you with the call of Islam; embrace Islam and you will be safe; Allah will give you your reward twice. But if you turn away, then you bear the sin of your people, and: O People of the Book, come to a word (a decree) that there is no dispute between us and you, that we worship none but Allah and we associate nothing with Him, and that none of us takes others as lords besides Allah. If they turn away, then say to them: Bear witness that we are those who submit (to Allah). Abu Sufyan said: 'After Heraclius said what he said and finished reading the letter, there was uproar and noisy voices, so we were driven out. I said to my companions after we were driven out: Indeed he has been called to the affair of the son of Abu Kabsyah. Heraclius fears for the kingdom of Rome. At that time I also feared that Muhammad would prevail, until finally (that feeling disappeared after) Allah entered me into Islam. And Ibnu An Nazhur, a noble of Iliya' and Heraclius, was a bishop of the Christian religion; he reported that one day when Heraclius visited Iliya' he was very troubled; some of his war commanders said: 'Indeed we disapprove of your condition.' Then Ibnu Nazhhur said: 'Heraclius was an astrologer who always observed the movements of the stars. He once answered the question of the priests who asked him: On one night when I was observing the movements of the stars, I saw that the king of the circumcised had been born; who among this ummah is circumcised?' The priests answered: 'Those who are circumcised are only the Jews; do not worry about those Jews. Just command all the lands in your kingdom so that the Jews in those lands are killed.' At that time a messenger of the king of Bani Ghassan was brought before Heraclius to tell about the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him; after that man finished telling, Heraclius ordered that he be examined, whether he was circumcised or not. After he was examined, it turned out that he was indeed circumcised. Then it was reported to Heraclius. Heraclius asked that man about the other Arabs: were they circumcised or not? He answered: 'The Arabs are all circumcised.' Heraclius said: 'This is the king of the ummah; indeed he has been born.' Then Heraclius sent a letter to a friend of his in Rome whose knowledge was equal to Heraclius' (to tell about the birth of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him). Meanwhile he continued his journey to the land of Himsha, but before arriving in Himsha, the reply from his friend arrived first. His friend agreed with Heraclius' opinion that Muhammad had been born and that he was indeed a Prophet. Heraclius then invited the nobles of Rome to come to his place in Himsha; after all of them were present in his assembly, Heraclius ordered all the doors to be locked. Then he said: 'O people of Rome, do you all want to obtain victory and great progress, while the kingdom remains intact in our hands? If you want it, acknowledge Muhammad as a Prophet!' Hearing that, they fled like wild donkeys, even though all the doors were locked. Seeing that situation, Heraclius lost hope that they would believe (in the prophethood of Muhammad). Then he ordered them all to return to their places and said: 'Indeed I said what I said only to test the firmness of your hearts. Now I have seen that firmness.' Then they prostrated before Heraclius and were pleased with him. That is the end of the story of Heraclius. It was narrated by [Shalih bin Kaisan] and [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri].
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Abu Al Yaman Al Hakam bin Nafi'], 彼は言った, 私たちに伝えた [Syu'aib] from [Az Zuhri], [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin 'Utbah bin Mas'ud] informed me that [Abdullah bin 'Abbas] informed him that [Abu Sufyan bin Harb] informed him; that Heraclius received a Quraisy 交易隊 that was on a 交易遠征 to the land of Syam at the time the 条約 between 預言者（彼に平安あれ）, and Abu Sufyan and the 不信仰の Quraisy was in force. When they stopped at Iliya', they 会った Heraclius at Heraclius' 招き to be 招いた to 対話 in his 集会, where Heraclius was then with the 貴族たち of the land of Rome. Heraclius spoke with them through an 通訳. Heraclius 言った: "Who あなたがたのうちに is 最も近い in 親族関係 to the 人間 who 預言者だと主張する?" Abu Sufyan 言った: "So I 答えた: 'I am the 最も近い in 親族関係 to him.'" Heraclius 言った: "Bring him close to me and also his 仲間たち." So they placed the Quraisy 民 behind Abu Sufyan. Then Heraclius 言った through his 通訳: "Tell him that I am asking him about the 人間 who 預言者だと主張する. If he lies to me, then you must call him a liar." アッラーにかけて, were it not for the 恥 of the 非難 of 嘘 that they would throw at me, I would certainly have lied to him. Abu Sufyan 言った: "Then the first thing he 尋ねた me about him (預言者（彼に平安あれ）) was: 'What is his 血統 あなたがたのうちに?' I 答えた: 'He is of good (高貴な) 血統.' He 尋ねた 再び: 'Was there anyone else who 言った it 彼より前に?' I 答えた: 'There was none.' He 尋ねた 再び: 'Was his father a 王?' I 答えた: 'No.' 'Do those who 従う him consist of the 名士たち or the 身分の低い人々?' I 答えた: 'Rather those who 従う him are the 身分の低い人々.' He 尋ねた 再び: 'Do his followers 増える or 減る?' I 答えた: 'They 増える.' He 尋ねた 再び: 'Is there anyone who 背教した out of 憎しみ for his 宗教?' I 答えた: 'There is none.' He 尋ねた 再び: 'Did you ever find him 嘘 before he 伝えられた what 彼は言った?' I 答えた: 'Never.' He 尋ねた 再び: 'Did he ever act 裏切って?' I 答えた: 'Never. When we dealt with him, he never did that.' Abu Sufyan 言った: 'I could not say anything other than words like this.' He 尋ねた 再び: 'Did you 戦う him?' I 答えた: 'Yes.' He 尋ねた 再び: 'How did the 戦争 end?' I 答えた: 'The 戦争 between us and him was very frequent. Sometimes he 打ち負かした us, sometimes we 打ち負かした him.' He 尋ねた 再び: 'What does he 命じよ you?' I 答えた: 'He commands us: アッラーを崇拝せよ without 並べること anything with Him, and leave what your 先祖たち 言った. He also commands us to 礼拝を確立せよ, ザカートを払え, 真実を語れ, 互いに赦し合え and 親族の絆を結べ.' Then Heraclius 言った to his 通訳: 'Tell him that I 尋ねた you about the 血統 of that 人間; you 語った me that that 人間 is of 高貴な 血統. Likewise a 人間 is 遣わされた among the 血統 of his 民. And I 尋ねた you whether anyone 彼より前に had 言った what 彼は言った; you 答えた no. If there had been someone 彼より前に who 言った it, I would certainly have considered this 人間 to be 真似る the one 彼より前に who had 言った something similar. I also 尋ねた you whether his father was of royal 血統; you 答えた no. I say, if his father had been of royal 血統, this 人間 would certainly be 求めている his father's 王国. And I also 尋ねた you whether you had ever found him 嘘 before he 伝えられた what 彼は言った; you 答えた no. Indeed I 理解する that if he does not あえて〜する to lie to 民, still まして would he lie to Allah. And I also 尋ねた you whether those who 従う him are the 名士たち or the 身分の低い人々? You 答えた that the 身分の低い人々 従う him. Indeed they are the ones who become the 使徒たちの追随者たち. I also 尋ねた you whether his followers 増える or 減る; you 答えた they 増える. And indeed that is how 信仰 is, until it becomes 完全になる. I also 尋ねた you whether anyone 背教した out of 怒り at his 宗教. You 答えた there is none. And indeed that is how 信仰 is when it has 入った and 育った in the 心. I also 尋ねた you whether he ever acted 裏切って; you 答えた never. And indeed that is how the Messengers are: they 裏切ることはできない. And I also 尋ねた you what he commands you; you 答えた that he commands you to アッラーを崇拝せよ without 並べること anything with Him, and to forbid you from worshipping 偶像; he also commands you to 礼拝を確立せよ, ザカートを払え, 真実を語れ, 互いに赦し合え and 親族の絆を結べ. If all that you say is true, he will surely 支配する the 王国 私の足下の. Indeed I had 疑っていた that he was not あなたがたのうちに now; if I knew a way to 彼に会う, I would certainly 懸命に努める to 会う him, so that when I was 彼のそばに I would 彼の両足を洗う. Then Heraclius 尋ねた for the 手紙 of the アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, which Dihyah had brought for the 支配者たち of the land of Bashrah; it was given to Heraclius, and he read it, and its 内容 were: アッラーの御名において, the 最も慈悲深い方, the 最も憐れみ深い方. From Muhammad, the アッラーのしもべ and 彼の使徒, to Heraclius, ローマの支配者: 導きに従う者に平安あれ. Furthermore, I 招く you with the イスラームの呼びかけ; イスラームに入れ and you will be 安全; Allah will 報奨を二倍にして与える. But if you 背を向ける, then you 罪を負う of あなたの民, and: O 啓典の民, 一つの言葉に来よ (a decree) that there is 争いがない between us and you, that we アッラー以外を崇拝しない and we associate nothing with Him, and that none of us アッラー以外を主とする. If they 背を向ける, then say to them: 証言せよ that we are those who 服従する (to Allah). Abu Sufyan 言った: 'After Heraclius 言った what 彼は言った and 終えた reading the 手紙, there was 騒ぎ and 騒がしい声, so we were 追い出された. I 言った to my 仲間たち after we were 追い出された: Indeed he has been called to the 事 of the アブー・カブシャの息子. Heraclius ローマ王国を恐れる. その時 I also feared that Muhammad would 勝利する, until ついに (that feeling disappeared after) Allah 私をイスラームに入れた. And Ibnu An Nazhur, a 高貴な of Iliya' and Heraclius, was a 司教 of the Christian 宗教; he 報告された that one day when Heraclius 訪れた Iliya' he was very 悩んだ; some of his 軍の指揮官たち 言った: 'Indeed we 認めない of your 様子.' Then Ibnu Nazhhur 言った: 'Heraclius was an 占星術師 who always 観察した the 星の動き. He once 答えた the question of the 祭司たち who 尋ねた him: On one 夜 when I was observing the 星の動き, I saw that the 割礼を受けた者の王 had 生まれた; who among this ウンマ is 割礼を受けた?' The 祭司たち 答えた: 'Those who are 割礼を受けた are only the Jews; do not 心配する about those Jews. Just 命じよ all the 土地 in your 王国 so that the Jews in those 土地 are 殺される.' その時 a 使者 of the バヌー・ガッサーンの王 was brought before Heraclius to tell about the アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）; after that 人間 終えた telling, Heraclius 命じた that he be 調べられた, whether he was 割礼を受けた or not. After he was 調べられた, it turned out that he was indeed 割礼を受けた. Then it was 報告された to Heraclius. Heraclius 尋ねた that 人間 about the other Arabs: were they 割礼を受けた or not? He 答えた: 'The Arabs are 皆割礼を受けている.' Heraclius 言った: 'This is the ウンマの王; indeed he has 生まれた.' Then Heraclius sent a 手紙 to a 友人 of his in Rome whose knowledge was 等しい to Heraclius' (to tell about the 誕生 of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him). Meanwhile he 旅を続けた to the land of Himsha, but before arriving in Himsha, the 返信 from his 友人 届いた first. His 友人 同意した with Heraclius' opinion that Muhammad had 生まれた and that he was まさに預言者. Heraclius then 招いた the 貴族たち of Rome to come to his place in Himsha; after all of them were 出席した in his 集会, Heraclius 命じた all the 扉 to be 閉ざされた. Then 彼は言った: 'O ローマの民よ, do you all want to obtain 勝利 and 大いなる進歩, while the 王国 無傷のまま残る in our hands? If you want it, ムハンマドを預言者として認めよ!' Hearing that, they 野ロバのように逃げた, even though all the 扉 were 閉ざされた. Seeing that situation, Heraclius 希望を失った that they would 信じる (in the 預言者であること of Muhammad). Then he 命じた them all to 戻れ to their 席 and 言った: 'Indeed I 言った what I 言った only to 試す the 堅固さ of your 心. Now I have seen that 堅固さ.' Then they 跪いた before Heraclius and were 喜んだ with him. That is the 物語の終わり of Heraclius. It was 伝えられた by [Shalih bin Kaisan] and [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri].
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Abu Al Yaman Al Hakam bin Nafi'], he 말했다, informed us [Syu'aib] from [Az Zuhri], [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin 'Utbah bin Mas'ud] informed me that [Abdullah bin 'Abbas] informed him that [Abu Sufyan bin Harb] informed him; that Heraclius received a Quraisy 상인 일행 that was on a 무역 원정 to the land of Syam at the time the 조약 between the Prophet, peace be upon him, and Abu Sufyan and the 불신하는 Quraisy was in force. When they stopped at Iliya', they 만났다 Heraclius at Heraclius' 초대 to be 초대했다 to 대화 in his 집회, where Heraclius was then with the 귀족들 of the land of Rome. Heraclius spoke with them through an 통역관. Heraclius 말했다: "Who 너희 중에 is 가장 가까운 in 혈연 관계 to the 인간 who 예언자라고 주장하는?" Abu Sufyan 말했다: "So I 대답했다: 'I am the 가장 가까운 in 혈연 관계 to him.'" Heraclius 말했다: "Bring him close to me and also his 동료들." So they placed the Quraisy 백성 behind Abu Sufyan. Then Heraclius 말했다 through his 통역관: "Tell him that I am asking him about the 인간 who 예언자라고 주장하는. If he lies to me, then you must call him a liar." 알라를 두고 맹세하건대, were it not for the 부끄러움 of the 비난 of 거짓말하다 that they would throw at me, I would certainly have lied to him. Abu Sufyan 말했다: "Then the first thing he 물었다 me about him (the Prophet, peace be upon him) was: 'What is his 혈통 너희 중에?' I 대답했다: 'He is of good (고귀한) 혈통.' He 물었다 다시: 'Was there anyone else who 말했다 it 그보다 먼저?' I 대답했다: 'There was none.' He 물었다 다시: 'Was his father a 왕?' I 대답했다: 'No.' 'Do those who 따르다 him consist of the 유력자들 or the 낮은 사람들?' I 대답했다: 'Rather those who 따르다 him are the 낮은 사람들.' He 물었다 다시: 'Do his followers 늘어난다 or 줄어든다?' I 대답했다: 'They 늘어난다.' He 물었다 다시: 'Is there anyone who 배교했다 out of 증오 for his 종교?' I 대답했다: 'There is none.' He 물었다 다시: 'Did you ever find him 거짓말하다 before he 전해졌다 what he 말했다?' I 대답했다: 'Never.' He 물었다 다시: 'Did he ever act 배신하며?' I 대답했다: 'Never. When we dealt with him, he never did that.' Abu Sufyan 말했다: 'I could not say anything other than words like this.' He 물었다 다시: 'Did you 싸우다 him?' I 대답했다: 'Yes.' He 물었다 다시: 'How did the 전쟁 end?' I 대답했다: 'The 전쟁 between us and him was very frequent. Sometimes he 패배시켰다 us, sometimes we 패배시켰다 him.' He 물었다 다시: 'What does he 명령하라 you?' I 대답했다: 'He commands us: 알라를 경배하라 without 결합시키는 것 anything with Him, and leave what your 조상들 말했다. He also commands us to 기도를 세우라, 자카트를 내라, 진실하게 말하라, 서로 용서하라 and 혈연을 이으라.' Then Heraclius 말했다 to his 통역관: 'Tell him that I 물었다 you about the 혈통 of that 인간; you 말했다 me that that 인간 is of 고귀한 혈통. Likewise a 인간 is 일으켜졌다 among the 혈통 of his 백성. And I 물었다 you whether anyone 그보다 먼저 had 말했다 what he 말했다; you 대답했다 no. If there had been someone 그보다 먼저 who 말했다 it, I would certainly have considered this 인간 to be 모방하는 the one 그보다 먼저 who had 말했다 something similar. I also 물었다 you whether his father was of royal 혈통; you 대답했다 no. I say, if his father had been of royal 혈통, this 인간 would certainly be 추구하는 his father's 왕국. And I also 물었다 you whether you had ever found him 거짓말하다 before he 전해졌다 what he 말했다; you 대답했다 no. Indeed I 이해하다 that if he does not 감히 ~하다 to lie to 백성, still less would he lie to Allah. And I also 물었다 you whether those who 따르다 him are the 유력자들 or the 낮은 사람들? You 대답했다 that the 낮은 사람들 따르다 him. Indeed they are the ones who become the 메신저들의 추종자들. I also 물었다 you whether his followers 늘어난다 or 줄어든다; you 대답했다 they 늘어난다. And indeed that is how 믿음 is, until it becomes 완전해지다. I also 물었다 you whether anyone 배교했다 out of 분노 at his 종교. You 대답했다 there is none. And indeed that is how 믿음 is when it has 들어갔다 and 자랐다 in the 마음. I also 물었다 you whether he ever acted 배신하며; you 대답했다 never. And indeed that is how the Messengers are: they 배신할 수 없다. And I also 물었다 you what he commands you; you 대답했다 that he commands you to 알라를 경배하라 without 결합시키는 것 anything with Him, and to forbid you from worshipping 우상; he also commands you to 기도를 세우라, 자카트를 내라, 진실하게 말하라, 서로 용서하라 and 혈연을 이으라. If all that you say is true, he will surely 다스리다 the 왕국 내 발 아래. Indeed I had 짐작했다 that he was not 너희 중에 now; if I knew a way to 그에게 도달하다, I would certainly 열심히 노력하다 to 만나다 him, so that when I was 그 옆에 I would 그의 두 발을 씻다. Then Heraclius 물었다 for the 편지 of the 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), which Dihyah had brought for the 통치자들 of the land of Bashrah; it was given to Heraclius, and he read it, and its 내용 were: 알라의 이름으로, the 가장 은혜로우신 분, the 가장 자비로우신 분. From Muhammad, the 알라의 종 and 그분의 메신저, to Heraclius, 로마의 통치자: 인도를 따르는 자에게 평화가 있기를. Furthermore, I 초대하다 you with the 이슬람의 부름; 이슬람에 들어가라 and you will be 안전할 것이다; Allah will 보상을 두 배로 주실 것이다. But if you 돌아서다, then you 죄를 지다 of 네 백성, and: O 경전의 백성, 한 말씀으로 오라 (a decree) that there is 다툼이 없는 between us and you, that we 알라 외에는 경배하지 않는다 and we associate nothing with Him, and that none of us 알라 외에 다른 이들을 주님으로 삼는다. If they 돌아서다, then say to them: 증언하라 that we are those who 복종하다 (to Allah). Abu Sufyan 말했다: 'After Heraclius 말했다 what he 말했다 and 마쳤다 reading the 편지, there was 소란 and 시끄러운 소리, so we were 쫓겨났다. I 말했다 to my 동료들 after we were 쫓겨났다: Indeed he has been called to the 일 of the 아부 카브샤의 아들. Heraclius 로마 왕국을 두려워하다. 그때 I also feared that Muhammad would 승리하다, until 마침내 (that feeling disappeared after) Allah 나를 이슬람에 들어가게 했다. And Ibnu An Nazhur, a 고귀한 of Iliya' and Heraclius, was a 주교 of the Christian 종교; he 보고되었다 that one day when Heraclius 방문했다 Iliya' he was very 괴로워했다; some of his 군 지휘관들 말했다: 'Indeed we 못마땅해하다 of your 상태.' Then Ibnu Nazhhur 말했다: 'Heraclius was an 점성가 who always 관찰했다 the 별들의 움직임. He once 대답했다 the question of the 사제들 who 물었다 him: On one 밤 when I was observing the 별들의 움직임, I saw that the 할례받은 자들의 왕 had 태어났다; who among this 움마 is 할례받은?' The 사제들 대답했다: 'Those who are 할례받은 are only the Jews; do not 걱정하다 about those Jews. Just 명령하라 all the 땅 in your 왕국 so that the Jews in those 땅 are 죽임을 당하다.' 그때 a 사자 of the 바누 가산의 왕 was brought before Heraclius to tell about the 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를); after that 인간 마쳤다 telling, Heraclius 명령했다 that he be 검사되었다, whether he was 할례받은 or not. After he was 검사되었다, it turned out that he was indeed 할례받은. Then it was 보고되었다 to Heraclius. Heraclius 물었다 that 인간 about the other Arabs: were they 할례받은 or not? He 대답했다: 'The Arabs are 모두 할례받았다.' Heraclius 말했다: 'This is the 움마의 왕; indeed he has 태어났다.' Then Heraclius sent a 편지 to a 친구 of his in Rome whose knowledge was 동등한 to Heraclius' (to tell about the 탄생 of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him). Meanwhile he 여정을 계속했다 to the land of Himsha, but before arriving in Himsha, the 답장 from his 친구 도착했다 first. His 친구 동의했다 with Heraclius' opinion that Muhammad had 태어났다 and that he was 참으로 예언자. Heraclius then 초대했다 the 귀족들 of Rome to come to his place in Himsha; after all of them were 참석한 in his 집회, Heraclius 명령했다 all the 문 to be 잠겼다. Then he 말했다: 'O 로마 백성이여, do you all want to obtain 승리 and 위대한 발전, while the 왕국 온전히 남아 있다 in our hands? If you want it, 무함마드를 예언자로 인정하라!' Hearing that, they 야생 나귀처럼 도망쳤다, even though all the 문 were 잠겼다. Seeing that situation, Heraclius 희망을 잃었다 that they would 믿다 (in the 예언자임 of Muhammad). Then he 명령했다 them all to 돌아가라 to their 자리 and 말했다: 'Indeed I 말했다 what I 말했다 only to 시험하다 the 굳건함 of your 마음. Now I have seen that 굳건함.' Then they 엎드렸다 before Heraclius and were 기뻐했다 with him. That is the 이야기의 끝 of Heraclius. It was 전해졌다 by [Shalih bin Kaisan] and [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri].

When they stopped at Iliya', they 去见 Heraclius at Heraclius' 邀请 to be 邀请 to 对话 in his 集会, where Heraclius was then with the 贵族们 of the land of Rome. Heraclius spoke with them through an 翻译. Heraclius 说: "Who 在你们之中 is 最亲近 in 亲属关系 to the 人类 who 自称先知?" Abu Sufyan 说: "So I 回答: 'I am the 最亲近 in 亲属关系 to him.'" Heraclius 说: "Bring him close to me and also his 同伴们." So they placed the Quraisy 族人 behind Abu Sufyan. Then Heraclius 说 through his 翻译: "Tell him that I am asking him about the 人类 who 自称先知. If he lies to me, then you must call him a liar." 以安拉发誓, were it not for the 羞耻 of the 指责 of 说谎 that they would throw at me, I would certainly have lied to him. Abu Sufyan 说: "Then the first thing he 问 me about him (the Prophet, peace be upon him) was: 'What is his 血统 在你们之中?' I 回答: 'He is of good (高贵的) 血统.' He 问 再一次: 'Was there anyone else who 说 it 在他之前?' I 回答: 'There was none.' He 问 再一次: 'Was his father a 国王?' I 回答: 'No.' 'Do those who 跟随 him consist of the 显贵们 or the 卑贱者?' I 回答: 'Rather those who 跟随 him are the 卑贱者.' He 问 再一次: 'Do his followers 增加 or 减少?' I 回答: 'They 增加.' He 问 再一次: 'Is there anyone who 叛教 out of 憎恨 for his 宗教?' I 回答: 'There is none.' He 问 再一次: 'Did you ever find him 说谎 before he 所传达的 what he 说?' I 回答: 'Never.' He 问 再一次: 'Did he ever act 背信弃义?' I 回答: 'Never. When we dealt with him, he never did that.' Abu Sufyan 说: 'I could not say anything other than words like this.' He 问 再一次: 'Did you 交战 him?' I 回答: 'Yes.' He 问 再一次: 'How did the 战争 end?' I 回答: 'The 战争 between us and him was very frequent. Sometimes he 打败 us, sometimes we 打败 him.' He 问 再一次: 'What does he 下令 you?' I 回答: 'He commands us: 崇拜安拉 without 以物配主 anything with Him, and leave what your 祖先们 说. He also commands us to 谨守拜功, 缴纳天课, 说真话, 互相宽恕 and 接续血缘.' Then Heraclius 说 to his 翻译: 'Tell him that I 问 you about the 血统 of that 人类; you 讲述 me that that 人类 is of 高贵的 血统. Likewise a 人类 is 被复活 among the 血统 of his 族人. And I 问 you whether anyone 在他之前 had 说 what he 说; you 回答 no. If there had been someone 在他之前 who 说 it, I would certainly have considered this 人类 to be 模仿 the one 在他之前 who had 说 something similar. I also 问 you whether his father was of royal 血统; you 回答 no. I say, if his father had been of royal 血统, this 人类 would certainly be 谋求 his father's 王国. And I also 问 you whether you had ever found him 说谎 before he 所传达的 what he 说; you 回答 no. Indeed I 理解 that if he does not 敢 to lie to 族人, still less would he lie to Allah. And I also 问 you whether those who 跟随 him are the 显贵们 or the 卑贱者? You 回答 that the 卑贱者 跟随 him. Indeed they are the ones who become the 使者们的追随者. I also 问 you whether his followers 增加 or 减少; you 回答 they 增加. And indeed that is how 信仰 is, until it becomes 完善. I also 问 you whether anyone 叛教 out of 愤怒 at his 宗教. You 回答 there is none. And indeed that is how 信仰 is when it has 进入 and 生长 in the 心中. I also 问 you whether he ever acted 背信弃义; you 回答 never. And indeed that is how the Messengers are: they 不会背信弃义. And I also 问 you what he commands you; you 回答 that he commands you to 崇拜安拉 without 以物配主 anything with Him, and to forbid you from worshipping 偶像; he also commands you to 谨守拜功, 缴纳天课, 说真话, 互相宽恕 and 接续血缘. If all that you say is true, he will surely 统治 the 王国 我的脚下. Indeed I had 猜想 that he was not 在你们之中 now; if I knew a way to 见到他, I would certainly 竭力 to 去见 him, so that when I was 在他身旁 I would 洗他的双脚. Then Heraclius 问 for the 信 of the 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, which Dihyah had brought for the 统治者们 of the land of Bashrah; it was given to Heraclius, and he read it, and its 内容 were: 奉安拉之名, the 至仁的主, the 至慈的主. From Muhammad, the 安拉的仆人 and 他的使者, to Heraclius, 罗马的统治者: 平安归于遵循正道者. Furthermore, I 邀请你 you with the 伊斯兰的号召; 皈依伊斯兰 and you will be 安全; Allah will 加倍给你报酬. But if you 转身离去, then you 承担罪责 of 你的人民, and: O 有经人, 来归于一句话 (a decree) that there is 没有分歧 between us and you, that we 只崇拜安拉 and we associate nothing with Him, and that none of us 舍安拉而以他人为主. If they 转身离去, then say to them: 你们作证吧 that we are those who 归顺 (to Allah). Abu Sufyan 说: 'After Heraclius 说 what he 说 and 诵完 reading the 信, there was 喧哗 and 嘈杂声, so we were 被赶出. I 说 to my 同伴们 after we were 被赶出: Indeed he has been called to the 事情 of the 阿布·卡布沙之子. Heraclius 为罗马王国担忧. 当时 I also feared that Muhammad would 获胜, until 最后 (that feeling disappeared after) Allah 使我进入伊斯兰. And Ibnu An Nazhur, a 高贵的 of Iliya' and Heraclius, was a 主教 of the Christian 宗教; he 被报告 that one day when Heraclius 访问 Iliya' he was very 忧虑; some of his 军中将领们 说: 'Indeed we 不赞成 of your 状况.' Then Ibnu Nazhhur 说: 'Heraclius was an 占星家 who always 观察 the 星辰运行. He once 回答 the question of the 祭司们 who 问 him: On one 夜晚 when I was observing the 星辰运行, I saw that the 受割礼者之王 had 已诞生; who among this 民族 is 受割礼的?' The 祭司们 回答: 'Those who are 受割礼的 are only the Jews; do not 担忧 about those Jews. Just 下令 all the 各地 in your 王国 so that the Jews in those 各地 are 被杀.' 当时 a 使者 of the 巴尼·加桑国王 was brought before Heraclius to tell about the 安拉的使者（愿他平安）; after that 人类 诵完 telling, Heraclius 命令 that he be 被检查, whether he was 受割礼的 or not. After he was 被检查, it turned out that he was indeed 受割礼的. Then it was 被报告 to Heraclius. Heraclius 问 that 人类 about the other Arabs: were they 受割礼的 or not? He 回答: 'The Arabs are 都受割礼.' Heraclius 说: 'This is the 民族之王; indeed he has 已诞生.' Then Heraclius sent a 信 to a 朋友 of his in Rome whose knowledge was 相当 to Heraclius' (to tell about the 诞生 of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him). Meanwhile he 继续行程 to the land of Himsha, but before arriving in Himsha, the 回信 from his 朋友 到达 first. His 朋友 一致认为 with Heraclius' opinion that Muhammad had 已诞生 and that he was 确是一位先知. Heraclius then 邀请 the 贵族们 of Rome to come to his place in Himsha; after all of them were 到场 in his 集会, Heraclius 命令 all the 门 to be 锁上. Then he 说: 'O 罗马人啊, do you all want to obtain 胜利 and 巨大的进步, while the 王国 保持完好 in our hands? If you want it, 承认穆罕默德为先知!' Hearing that, they 像野驴一样逃窜, even though all the 门 were 锁上. Seeing that situation, Heraclius 失去了希望 that they would 相信 (in the 先知身份 of Muhammad). Then he 命令 them all to 回去吧 to their 座位 and 说: 'Indeed I 说 what I 说 only to 考验 the 坚定 of your 心. Now I have seen that 坚定.' Then they 叩头 before Heraclius and were 高兴 with him. That is the 故事的结尾 of Heraclius. It was 传述 by [Shalih bin Kaisan] and [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri].
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Abu Al Yaman Al Hakam bin Nafi'], he a dit, informed us [Syu'aib] from [Az Zuhri], [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin 'Utbah bin Mas'ud] informed me that [Abdullah bin 'Abbas] informed him that [Abu Sufyan bin Harb] informed him; that Heraclius received a Quraisy caravane de marchands that was on a expédition commerciale to the land of Syam at the time the traité between the Prophet, peace be upon him, and Abu Sufyan and the mécréants Quraisy was in force. When they stopped at Iliya', they a rencontré Heraclius at Heraclius' invitation to be a invité to dialogue in his assemblée, where Heraclius was then with the nobles of the land of Rome. Heraclius spoke with them through an interprète. Heraclius a dit: "Who parmi vous is le plus proche in liens familiaux to the homme who prétend être un Prophète?" Abu Sufyan a dit: "So I a répondu: 'I am the le plus proche in liens familiaux to him.'" Heraclius a dit: "Bring him close to me and also his compagnons." So they placed the Quraisy peuple behind Abu Sufyan. Then Heraclius a dit through his interprète: "Tell him that I am asking him about the homme who prétend être un Prophète. If he lies to me, then you must call him a liar." Par Allah, were it not for the honte of the accusation of mentir that they would throw at me, I would certainly have lied to him. Abu Sufyan a dit: "Then the first thing he a demandé me about him (the Prophet, peace be upon him) was: 'What is his lignée parmi vous?' I a répondu: 'He is of good (noble) lignée.' He a demandé à nouveau: 'Was there anyone else who a dit it avant lui?' I a répondu: 'There was none.' He a demandé à nouveau: 'Was his father a roi?' I a répondu: 'No.' 'Do those who suivre him consist of the notables or the gens humbles?' I a répondu: 'Rather those who suivre him are the gens humbles.' He a demandé à nouveau: 'Do his followers augmentent or diminuent?' I a répondu: 'They augmentent.' He a demandé à nouveau: 'Is there anyone who a apostasié out of haine for his religion?' I a répondu: 'There is none.' He a demandé à nouveau: 'Did you ever find him mentir before he transmis what he a dit?' I a répondu: 'Never.' He a demandé à nouveau: 'Did he ever act avec trahison?' I a répondu: 'Never. When we dealt with him, he never did that.' Abu Sufyan a dit: 'I could not say anything other than words like this.' He a demandé à nouveau: 'Did you combattre him?' I a répondu: 'Yes.' He a demandé à nouveau: 'How did the guerre end?' I a répondu: 'The guerre between us and him was very frequent. Sometimes he a vaincu us, sometimes we a vaincu him.' He a demandé à nouveau: 'What does he ordonne you?' I a répondu: 'He commands us: Adorez Allah without associer anything with Him, and leave what your ancêtres a dit. He also commands us to accomplir la prière, acquitter la zakat, dire la vérité, se pardonner mutuellement and entretenir les liens de parenté.' Then Heraclius a dit to his interprète: 'Tell him that I a demandé you about the lignée of that homme; you a raconté me that that homme is of noble lignée. Likewise a homme is suscité among the lignée of his peuple. And I a demandé you whether anyone avant lui had a dit what he a dit; you a répondu no. If there had been someone avant lui who a dit it, I would certainly have considered this homme to be imitant the one avant lui who had a dit something similar. I also a demandé you whether his father was of royal lignée; you a répondu no. I say, if his father had been of royal lignée, this homme would certainly be recherchant his father's royaume. And I also a demandé you whether you had ever found him mentir before he transmis what he a dit; you a répondu no. Indeed I comprendre that if he does not oser to lie to peuple, still less would he lie to Allah. And I also a demandé you whether those who suivre him are the notables or the gens humbles? You a répondu that the gens humbles suivre him. Indeed they are the ones who become the disciples des Messagers. I also a demandé you whether his followers augmentent or diminuent; you a répondu they augmentent. And indeed that is how foi is, until it becomes parfaite. I also a demandé you whether anyone a apostasié out of colère at his religion. You a répondu there is none. And indeed that is how foi is when it has est entrée and a grandi in the cœur. I also a demandé you whether he ever acted avec trahison; you a répondu never. And indeed that is how the Messengers are: they ne peuvent trahir. And I also a demandé you what he commands you; you a répondu that he commands you to Adorez Allah without associer anything with Him, and to forbid you from worshipping idoles; he also commands you to accomplir la prière, acquitter la zakat, dire la vérité, se pardonner mutuellement and entretenir les liens de parenté. If all that you say is true, he will surely régnera the royaume sous mes pieds. Indeed I had avais soupçonné that he was not parmi vous now; if I knew a way to l'atteindre, I would certainly m'efforcer to rencontrer him, so that when I was à ses côtés I would laver ses deux pieds. Then Heraclius a demandé for the lettre of the Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, which Dihyah had brought for the gouverneurs of the land of Bashrah; it was given to Heraclius, and he read it, and its contenu were: Au nom d'Allah, the le Très Gracieux, the le Très Miséricordieux. From Muhammad, the serviteur d'Allah and Son Messager, to Heraclius, souverain de Rome: Paix sur celui qui suit la guidée. Furthermore, I t'invite you with the appel de l'Islam; embrasse l'Islam and you will be sauf; Allah will te donnera ta récompense deux fois. But if you te détournes, then you porteras le péché of ton peuple, and: O gens du Livre, venons à une parole (a decree) that there is sans dispute between us and you, that we n'adorons qu'Allah and we associate nothing with Him, and that none of us ne prenons d'autres seigneurs qu'Allah. If they te détournes, then say to them: Témoignez that we are those who soumis (to Allah). Abu Sufyan a dit: 'After Heraclius a dit what he a dit and a terminé reading the lettre, there was tumulte and voix bruyantes, so we were chassés. I a dit to my compagnons after we were chassés: Indeed he has been called to the affaire of the fils d'Abu Kabsyah. Heraclius craint pour le royaume de Rome. à cette époque I also feared that Muhammad would triomphera, until enfin (that feeling disappeared after) Allah m'a fait entrer en Islam. And Ibnu An Nazhur, a noble of Iliya' and Heraclius, was a évêque of the Christian religion; he rapporté that one day when Heraclius a visité Iliya' he was very troublé; some of his commandants de guerre a dit: 'Indeed we désapprouvent of your état.' Then Ibnu Nazhhur a dit: 'Heraclius was an astrologue who always observais the mouvements des étoiles. He once a répondu the question of the prêtres who a demandé him: On one nuit when I was observing the mouvements des étoiles, I saw that the roi des circoncis had est né; who among this umma is circoncis?' The prêtres a répondu: 'Those who are circoncis are only the Jews; do not t'inquiète about those Jews. Just ordonne all the terres in your royaume so that the Jews in those terres are tués.' à cette époque a messager of the roi de Bani Ghassan was brought before Heraclius to tell about the Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui; after that homme a terminé telling, Heraclius a ordonné that he be examiné, whether he was circoncis or not. After he was examiné, it turned out that he was indeed circoncis. Then it was rapporté to Heraclius. Heraclius a demandé that homme about the other Arabs: were they circoncis or not? He a répondu: 'The Arabs are tous circoncis.' Heraclius a dit: 'This is the roi de la umma; indeed he has est né.' Then Heraclius sent a lettre to a ami of his in Rome whose knowledge was égal to Heraclius' (to tell about the naissance of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him). Meanwhile he a poursuivi son voyage to the land of Himsha, but before arriving in Himsha, the réponse from his ami est arrivée first. His ami étaient d'accord with Heraclius' opinion that Muhammad had est né and that he was bien un Prophète. Heraclius then a invité the nobles of Rome to come to his place in Himsha; after all of them were présents in his assemblée, Heraclius a ordonné all the portes to be verrouillées. Then he a dit: 'O peuple de Rome, do you all want to obtain victoire and grand progrès, while the royaume reste intact in our hands? If you want it, reconnaissez Muhammad comme Prophète!' Hearing that, they ont fui comme des ânes sauvages, even though all the portes were verrouillées. Seeing that situation, Heraclius a perdu espoir that they would croient (in the prophétie of Muhammad). Then he a ordonné them all to retournez to their places and a dit: 'Indeed I a dit what I a dit only to éprouver the fermeté of your cœurs. Now I have seen that fermeté.' Then they se sont prosternés before Heraclius and were satisfaits with him. That is the fin de l'histoire of Heraclius. It was rapporté by [Shalih bin Kaisan] and [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri].
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Abu Al Yaman Al Hakam bin Nafi'], he sagte, informed us [Syu'aib] from [Az Zuhri], [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin 'Utbah bin Mas'ud] informed me that [Abdullah bin 'Abbas] informed him that [Abu Sufyan bin Harb] informed him; that Heraclius received a Quraisy Handelskarawane that was on a Handelsexpedition to the land of Syam at the time the Vertrag between the Prophet, peace be upon him, and Abu Sufyan and the ungläubigen Quraisy was in force. When they stopped at Iliya', they traf Heraclius at Heraclius' Einladung to be lud ein to Gespräch in his Versammlung, where Heraclius was then with the Adligen of the land of Rome. Heraclius spoke with them through an Dolmetscher. Heraclius sagte: "Who unter euch is nächste in familiäre Bande to the Mensch who behauptet, ein Prophet zu sein?" Abu Sufyan sagte: "So I antwortete: 'I am the nächste in familiäre Bande to him.'" Heraclius sagte: "Bring him close to me and also his Gefährten." So they placed the Quraisy Volk behind Abu Sufyan. Then Heraclius sagte through his Dolmetscher: "Tell him that I am asking him about the Mensch who behauptet, ein Prophet zu sein. If he lies to me, then you must call him a liar." Bei Allah, were it not for the Scham of the Vorwurf of lügen that they would throw at me, I would certainly have lied to him. Abu Sufyan sagte: "Then the first thing he fragte me about him (the Prophet, peace be upon him) was: 'What is his Abstammung unter euch?' I antwortete: 'He is of good (adlig) Abstammung.' He fragte wieder: 'Was there anyone else who sagte it vor ihm?' I antwortete: 'There was none.' He fragte wieder: 'Was his father a König?' I antwortete: 'No.' 'Do those who folge him consist of the Angesehene or the niedrige Leute?' I antwortete: 'Rather those who folge him are the niedrige Leute.' He fragte wieder: 'Do his followers nehmen zu or nehmen ab?' I antwortete: 'They nehmen zu.' He fragte wieder: 'Is there anyone who abgefallen ist out of Hass for his Religion?' I antwortete: 'There is none.' He fragte wieder: 'Did you ever find him lügen before he übermittelt wurde what he sagte?' I antwortete: 'Never.' He fragte wieder: 'Did he ever act treulos?' I antwortete: 'Never. When we dealt with him, he never did that.' Abu Sufyan sagte: 'I could not say anything other than words like this.' He fragte wieder: 'Did you bekämpfen him?' I antwortete: 'Yes.' He fragte wieder: 'How did the Krieg end?' I antwortete: 'The Krieg between us and him was very frequent. Sometimes he besiegte us, sometimes we besiegte him.' He fragte wieder: 'What does he befiehl you?' I antwortete: 'He commands us: Betet Allah an without etwas beigesellen anything with Him, and leave what your Vorfahren sagte. He also commands us to das Gebet verrichten, die Zakat entrichten, wahrhaftig sprechen, einander vergeben and die Verwandtschaftsbande pflegen.' Then Heraclius sagte to his Dolmetscher: 'Tell him that I fragte you about the Abstammung of that Mensch; you erzählte me that that Mensch is of adlig Abstammung. Likewise a Mensch is erweckt among the Abstammung of his Volk. And I fragte you whether anyone vor ihm had sagte what he sagte; you antwortete no. If there had been someone vor ihm who sagte it, I would certainly have considered this Mensch to be nachahmen the one vor ihm who had sagte something similar. I also fragte you whether his father was of royal Abstammung; you antwortete no. I say, if his father had been of royal Abstammung, this Mensch would certainly be erstreben his father's Königreich. And I also fragte you whether you had ever found him lügen before he übermittelt wurde what he sagte; you antwortete no. Indeed I verstehen that if he does not wagen to lie to Volk, still less would he lie to Allah. And I also fragte you whether those who folge him are the Angesehene or the niedrige Leute? You antwortete that the niedrige Leute folge him. Indeed they are the ones who become the Anhänger der Gesandten. I also fragte you whether his followers nehmen zu or nehmen ab; you antwortete they nehmen zu. And indeed that is how Glaube is, until it becomes vollkommen. I also fragte you whether anyone abgefallen ist out of Zorn at his Religion. You antwortete there is none. And indeed that is how Glaube is when it has eingetreten ist and gewachsen ist in the Herz. I also fragte you whether he ever acted treulos; you antwortete never. And indeed that is how the Messengers are: they können nicht treulos handeln. And I also fragte you what he commands you; you antwortete that he commands you to Betet Allah an without etwas beigesellen anything with Him, and to forbid you from worshipping Götzen; he also commands you to das Gebet verrichten, die Zakat entrichten, wahrhaftig sprechen, einander vergeben and die Verwandtschaftsbande pflegen. If all that you say is true, he will surely herrschen the Königreich unter meinen Füßen. Indeed I had vermutet that he was not unter euch now; if I knew a way to ihn erreichen, I would certainly mich sehr bemühen to treffen him, so that when I was an seiner Seite I would seine beiden Füße waschen. Then Heraclius fragte for the Brief of the Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, which Dihyah had brought for the Herrscher of the land of Bashrah; it was given to Heraclius, and he read it, and its Inhalt were: Im Namen Allahs, the Allergnädigsten, the Allerbarmers. From Muhammad, the Diener Allahs and Sein Gesandter, to Heraclius, Herrscher Roms: Friede sei mit dem, der der Rechtleitung folgt. Furthermore, I lade dich ein you with the Ruf des Islam; nimm den Islam an and you will be sicher; Allah will wird dir deinen Lohn zweimal geben. But if you dich abwendest, then you trägst die Sünde of deines Volkes, and: O Leute der Schrift, kommt zu einem Wort (a decree) that there is kein Streit between us and you, that we nur Allah anbeten and we associate nothing with Him, and that none of us andere als Herren neben Allah nehmen. If they dich abwendest, then say to them: Bezeugt that we are those who ergeben (to Allah). Abu Sufyan sagte: 'After Heraclius sagte what he sagte and beendet haben reading the Brief, there was Tumult and laute Stimmen, so we were hinausgetrieben. I sagte to my Gefährten after we were hinausgetrieben: Indeed he has been called to the Angelegenheit of the Sohn des Abu Kabsyah. Heraclius fürchtet um das Königreich Rom. zu jener Zeit I also feared that Muhammad would siegen, until schließlich (that feeling disappeared after) Allah mich in den Islam eintreten ließ. And Ibnu An Nazhur, a adlig of Iliya' and Heraclius, was a Bischof of the Christian Religion; he berichtet that one day when Heraclius besuchte Iliya' he was very beunruhigt; some of his Kriegsbefehlshaber sagte: 'Indeed we missbilligen of your Zustand.' Then Ibnu Nazhhur sagte: 'Heraclius was an Astrologe who always beobachtete the Bewegungen der Sterne. He once antwortete the question of the Priester who fragte him: On one Nacht when I was observing the Bewegungen der Sterne, I saw that the König der Beschnittenen had geboren worden; who among this Umma is beschnitten?' The Priester antwortete: 'Those who are beschnitten are only the Jews; do not sorge dich about those Jews. Just befiehl all the Länder in your Königreich so that the Jews in those Länder are getötet werden.' zu jener Zeit a Bote of the König der Bani Ghassan was brought before Heraclius to tell about the Gesandter Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm; after that Mensch beendet haben telling, Heraclius befahl that he be untersucht, whether he was beschnitten or not. After he was untersucht, it turned out that he was indeed beschnitten. Then it was berichtet to Heraclius. Heraclius fragte that Mensch about the other Arabs: were they beschnitten or not? He antwortete: 'The Arabs are alle beschnitten.' Heraclius sagte: 'This is the König der Umma; indeed he has geboren worden.' Then Heraclius sent a Brief to a Freund of his in Rome whose knowledge was gleich to Heraclius' (to tell about the Geburt of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him). Meanwhile he setzte seine Reise fort to the land of Himsha, but before arriving in Himsha, the Antwort from his Freund traf ein first. His Freund waren sich einig with Heraclius' opinion that Muhammad had geboren worden and that he was wahrlich ein Prophet. Heraclius then lud ein the Adligen of Rome to come to his place in Himsha; after all of them were anwesend in his Versammlung, Heraclius befahl all the Türen to be verschlossen. Then he sagte: 'O Volk von Rom, do you all want to obtain Sieg and großer Fortschritt, while the Königreich unversehrt bleibt in our hands? If you want it, Muhammad als Propheten anerkennen!' Hearing that, they flohen wie wilde Esel, even though all the Türen were verschlossen. Seeing that situation, Heraclius verlor die Hoffnung that they would glauben (in the Prophetentum of Muhammad). Then he befahl them all to kehrt zurück to their Plätze and sagte: 'Indeed I sagte what I sagte only to prüfen the Festigkeit of your Herzen. Now I have seen that Festigkeit.' Then they warfen sich nieder before Heraclius and were erfreut with him. That is the Ende der Geschichte of Heraclius. It was überliefert by [Shalih bin Kaisan] and [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri].
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Abu Al Yaman Al Hakam bin Nafi'], he ha detto, informed us [Syu'aib] from [Az Zuhri], [Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin 'Utbah bin Mas'ud] informed me that [Abdullah bin 'Abbas] informed him that [Abu Sufyan bin Harb] informed him; that Heraclius received a Quraisy carovana di mercanti that was on a spedizione commerciale to the land of Syam at the time the trattato between the Prophet, peace be upon him, and Abu Sufyan and the miscredenti Quraisy was in force. When they stopped at Iliya', they ha incontrato Heraclius at Heraclius' invito to be ha invitato to dialogo in his assemblea, where Heraclius was then with the nobili of the land of Rome. Heraclius spoke with them through an interprete. Heraclius ha detto: "Who tra voi is il più vicino in legami familiari to the uomo who pretende di essere un Profeta?" Abu Sufyan ha detto: "So I ha risposto: 'I am the il più vicino in legami familiari to him.'" Heraclius ha detto: "Bring him close to me and also his compagni." So they placed the Quraisy popolo behind Abu Sufyan. Then Heraclius ha detto through his interprete: "Tell him that I am asking him about the uomo who pretende di essere un Profeta. If he lies to me, then you must call him a liar." Per Allah, were it not for the vergogna of the accusa of mentire that they would throw at me, I would certainly have lied to him. Abu Sufyan ha detto: "Then the first thing he ha chiesto me about him (the Prophet, peace be upon him) was: 'What is his lignaggio tra voi?' I ha risposto: 'He is of good (nobile) lignaggio.' He ha chiesto di nuovo: 'Was there anyone else who ha detto it prima di lui?' I ha risposto: 'There was none.' He ha chiesto di nuovo: 'Was his father a re?' I ha risposto: 'No.' 'Do those who seguo him consist of the notabili or the gente umile?' I ha risposto: 'Rather those who seguo him are the gente umile.' He ha chiesto di nuovo: 'Do his followers aumentano or diminuiscono?' I ha risposto: 'They aumentano.' He ha chiesto di nuovo: 'Is there anyone who ha apostatato out of odio for his religione?' I ha risposto: 'There is none.' He ha chiesto di nuovo: 'Did you ever find him mentire before he trasmesso what he ha detto?' I ha risposto: 'Never.' He ha chiesto di nuovo: 'Did he ever act con tradimento?' I ha risposto: 'Never. When we dealt with him, he never did that.' Abu Sufyan ha detto: 'I could not say anything other than words like this.' He ha chiesto di nuovo: 'Did you combattere him?' I ha risposto: 'Yes.' He ha chiesto di nuovo: 'How did the guerra end?' I ha risposto: 'The guerra between us and him was very frequent. Sometimes he ha sconfitto us, sometimes we ha sconfitto him.' He ha chiesto di nuovo: 'What does he ordina you?' I ha risposto: 'He commands us: Adorate Allah without associare anything with Him, and leave what your antenati ha detto. He also commands us to compiere la preghiera, versare la zakat, dire la verità, perdonarsi a vicenda and mantenere i legami di parentela.' Then Heraclius ha detto to his interprete: 'Tell him that I ha chiesto you about the lignaggio of that uomo; you ha raccontato me that that uomo is of nobile lignaggio. Likewise a uomo is suscitato among the lignaggio of his popolo. And I ha chiesto you whether anyone prima di lui had ha detto what he ha detto; you ha risposto no. If there had been someone prima di lui who ha detto it, I would certainly have considered this uomo to be imitando the one prima di lui who had ha detto something similar. I also ha chiesto you whether his father was of royal lignaggio; you ha risposto no. I say, if his father had been of royal lignaggio, this uomo would certainly be cercando his father's regno. And I also ha chiesto you whether you had ever found him mentire before he trasmesso what he ha detto; you ha risposto no. Indeed I capire that if he does not osare to lie to popolo, still less would he lie to Allah. And I also ha chiesto you whether those who seguo him are the notabili or the gente umile? You ha risposto that the gente umile seguo him. Indeed they are the ones who become the seguaci dei Messaggeri. I also ha chiesto you whether his followers aumentano or diminuiscono; you ha risposto they aumentano. And indeed that is how fede is, until it becomes perfetta. I also ha chiesto you whether anyone ha apostatato out of rabbia at his religione. You ha risposto there is none. And indeed that is how fede is when it has è entrata and è cresciuta in the cuore. I also ha chiesto you whether he ever acted con tradimento; you ha risposto never. And indeed that is how the Messengers are: they non possono tradire. And I also ha chiesto you what he commands you; you ha risposto that he commands you to Adorate Allah without associare anything with Him, and to forbid you from worshipping idoli; he also commands you to compiere la preghiera, versare la zakat, dire la verità, perdonarsi a vicenda and mantenere i legami di parentela. If all that you say is true, he will surely dominerà the regno sotto i miei piedi. Indeed I had avevo sospettato that he was not tra voi now; if I knew a way to raggiungerlo, I would certainly sforzarmi molto to incontrare him, so that when I was al suo fianco I would lavare i suoi due piedi. Then Heraclius ha chiesto for the lettera of the Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, which Dihyah had brought for the governanti of the land of Bashrah; it was given to Heraclius, and he read it, and its contenuto were: Nel nome di Allah, the il più Clementissimo, the il più Misericordioso. From Muhammad, the servo di Allah and il Suo Messaggero, to Heraclius, sovrano di Roma: Pace su chi segue la guida. Furthermore, I ti invito you with the chiamata dell'Islam; abbraccia l'Islam and you will be salvo; Allah will ti darà la tua ricompensa due volte. But if you ti allontani, then you porterai il peccato of del tuo popolo, and: O gente del Libro, veniamo a una parola (a decree) that there is senza disputa between us and you, that we adoriamo solo Allah and we associate nothing with Him, and that none of us prendiamo altri come signori oltre Allah. If they ti allontani, then say to them: Testimoniate that we are those who sottomessi (to Allah). Abu Sufyan ha detto: 'After Heraclius ha detto what he ha detto and abbiamo finito reading the lettera, there was tumulto and voci rumorose, so we were cacciati. I ha detto to my compagni after we were cacciati: Indeed he has been called to the affare of the figlio di Abu Kabsyah. Heraclius teme per il regno di Roma. a quel tempo I also feared that Muhammad would prevarrà, until finalmente (that feeling disappeared after) Allah mi ha fatto entrare nell'Islam. And Ibnu An Nazhur, a nobile of Iliya' and Heraclius, was a vescovo of the Christian religione; he riferito that one day when Heraclius ha visitato Iliya' he was very turbato; some of his comandanti di guerra ha detto: 'Indeed we disapprovano of your condizione.' Then Ibnu Nazhhur ha detto: 'Heraclius was an astrologo who always osservavo the movimenti delle stelle. He once ha risposto the question of the sacerdoti who ha chiesto him: On one notte when I was observing the movimenti delle stelle, I saw that the re dei circoncisi had è nato; who among this umma is circoncisi?' The sacerdoti ha risposto: 'Those who are circoncisi are only the Jews; do not preoccuparti about those Jews. Just ordina all the terre in your regno so that the Jews in those terre are uccisi.' a quel tempo a messaggero of the re di Bani Ghassan was brought before Heraclius to tell about the Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui; after that uomo abbiamo finito telling, Heraclius ha ordinato that he be esaminato, whether he was circoncisi or not. After he was esaminato, it turned out that he was indeed circoncisi. Then it was riferito to Heraclius. Heraclius ha chiesto that uomo about the other Arabs: were they circoncisi or not? He ha risposto: 'The Arabs are tutti circoncisi.' Heraclius ha detto: 'This is the re della umma; indeed he has è nato.' Then Heraclius sent a lettera to a amico of his in Rome whose knowledge was pari to Heraclius' (to tell about the nascita of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him). Meanwhile he ha proseguito il suo viaggio to the land of Himsha, but before arriving in Himsha, the risposta from his amico è arrivata first. His amico erano d'accordo with Heraclius' opinion that Muhammad had è nato and that he was davvero un Profeta. Heraclius then ha invitato the nobili of Rome to come to his place in Himsha; after all of them were presenti in his assemblea, Heraclius ha ordinato all the porte to be chiuse. Then he ha detto: 'O popolo di Roma, do you all want to obtain vittoria and grande progresso, while the regno resta intatto in our hands? If you want it, riconoscete Muhammad come Profeta!' Hearing that, they fuggirono come asini selvatici, even though all the porte were chiuse. Seeing that situation, Heraclius ha perso la speranza that they would credano (in the profezia of Muhammad). Then he ha ordinato them all to tornate to their posti and ha detto: 'Indeed I ha detto what I ha detto only to mettere alla prova the fermezza of your cuori. Now I have seen that fermezza.' Then they si sono prostrati before Heraclius and were contenti with him. That is the fine della storia of Heraclius. It was narrato by [Shalih bin Kaisan] and [Yunus] and [Ma'mar] from [Az Zuhri].
